title: Bilingual Civil Engineer (Load analysis: Structural conditions of rooftops/framing systems)
description:
The Company

Datamtx ( / formerly Datamatics) established in 1993 and globally HQ'd in Atlanta has a stellar history supporting both Tier 1 and 2 Manufacturing ERP rollouts ranging from implementations, data cleanse, migrations, customization, hypercare and Day 1 support. We are also nationally aligned with leading accounting firms & VARs.

Our ERP / CRM coverage includes: SAP, Oracle EBS/Fusion, Oracle Cloud ERP, Peoplesoft, JDE, Infor (M3, LX, XA, LN, System 21), IFS, Epicor, SysPro, D365 & Salesforce.

One of our longest standing service verticals has been assisting transition clients from legacy systems to cloud based platforms including introduction of Cloud / GenAI and MS-Fabric, RAG models.


We are seeking a multiple Civil Engineers with emphasis on Load analysis: Structural conditions of rooftops/framing systems.

English language proficiency is mandatory.


These are remote roles.


This is a Civil Engineering client who are a market leader in the renewable energy industry. Ideally, they would like to start someone by early February for 11 months with an option to extend annually.

ROLES:

1) Civil Engineers (3+ years of experience)

2) Associate Civil Engineer: ACE (0-3 years of experience)


Executive Summary

Our client is dedicated to maintaining high-volume production speeds without compromising the rigorous structural safety and code compliance standards required for a 25-year system life. We require a scalable solution where a vendor-managed team can execute technical reviews, resolve engineering escalations, and maintain seamless communication across our design-to-installation pipeline.


Primary Duties

  • Reviewing structural conditions of rooftops and framing systems
  • Designing or verifying the configuration of racking and attachment systems
  • Performing load analysis to ensure compliance with applicable safety standards and expected performance over a 25-year system life
  • Working in a high-volume production environment, completing multiple project assessments per day, with some engineers averaging multiple evaluations per hour
  • The ability to maintain accuracy and consistency at scale is critical.
  • Regular shifting of work schedule may be required to support seasonal business needs
  • Turnaround Times: Core tasks are measured in business hours with expectations ranging from 4 to 24 hours depending on the task type.
  • Quality & Accountability: Staff must maintain a 95% quality score ; consistent failure to meet these standards requires a Performance Improvement Plan within 10 business days.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in an engineering discipline, with preference for civil or structural engineering
  • Professional accreditation or licensure in their home country (preferred but not mandatory)
  • Proficiency in technical analysis and structural design tools is a plus but not required
  • Strong English communication skills for coordination with US-based engineering leads


Experience level

  • Associate Civil Engineer-ACE: 0–3 years of relevant experience, ideal for early-career engineers seeking growth in a specialized field
  • Civil Engineer: 3+ years of relevant experience, ideal for early-career engineers seeking growth in a specialized field

We are seeking a multiple Civil Engineers with emphasis on Load analysis: Structural conditions of rooftops/framing systems.

English language proficiency is mandatory.


These are remote roles.


This is a Civil Engineering client who are a market leader in the renewable energy industry. Ideally, they would like to start someone by early February for 11 months with an option to extend annually.

ROLES:

1) Civil Engineers (3+ years of experience)

2) Associate Civil Engineer: ACE (0-3 years of experience)


Executive Summary

Our client is dedicated to maintaining high-volume production speeds without compromising the rigorous structural safety and code compliance standards required for a 25-year system life. We require a scalable solution where a vendor-managed team can execute technical reviews, resolve engineering escalations, and maintain seamless communication across our design-to-installation pipeline.


Primary Duties

  • Reviewing structural conditions of rooftops and framing systems
  • Designing or verifying the configuration of racking and attachment systems
  • Performing load analysis to ensure compliance with applicable safety standards and expected performance over a 25-year system life
  • Working in a high-volume production environment, completing multiple project assessments per day, with some engineers averaging multiple evaluations per hour
  • The ability to maintain accuracy and consistency at scale is critical.
  • Regular shifting of work schedule may be required to support seasonal business needs
  • Turnaround Times: Core tasks are measured in business hours with expectations ranging from 4 to 24 hours depending on the task type.
  • Quality & Accountability: Staff must maintain a 95% quality score ; consistent failure to meet these standards requires a Performance Improvement Plan within 10 business days.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in an engineering discipline, with preference for civil or structural engineering
  • Professional accreditation or licensure in their home country (preferred but not mandatory)
  • Proficiency in technical analysis and structural design tools is a plus but not required
  • Strong English communication skills for coordination with US-based engineering leads


Experience level

  • Associate Civil Engineer-ACE: 0–3 years of relevant experience, ideal for early-career engineers seeking growth in a specialized field
  • Civil Engineer: 3+ years of relevant experience, ideal for early-career engineers seeking growth in a specialized field

description:
Python/Cloud Platform Developer


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


We seek an experienced high-performing Python engineer for a position supporting and developing new tools and processes to be used on an on-prem private cloud application. Responsibilities and Duties


  • Develop high performance cloud and container technologies mostly leveraging Python as the main programming language;

Essential Skills


  • Solid backend developer (preferably but not restricted to Python), knowledgeable in Linux Essentials:
  • Medium knowledge in concepts of hardware, processes, programs and the components of the Linux Operating System;
  • How to work on the command line and with files;
  • How to create and restore compressed backups and archives;
  • System security: users/groups and file permissions for public and private directories;
  • How to create and run simple scripts;
  • Interested in working on development and troubleshooting of a highly distributed orchestration platform supporting multiple vendors;
  • Strong computer networking knowledge and transport (TCP/UDP/etc.) layers;
  • Knowledge of cloud computing concepts;

Highly Desirable Skills

title: Scrum Master Sr
description:
Job Description

A Genesis Consulting tem uma oportunidade imediata para Scrum Masters experientes e com verdadeira paixão por crescimento profissional e transformação de negócios através do lean-agile. Nossos clientes são alguns dos principais líderes mundiais em diferentes indústrias e o candidato fará parte de projetos desafiadores para construir e apoiar soluções técnicas para suas necessidades. Junte-se ao nosso time e seja um agente facilitador de resultados de negócios através dos conceitos de Business Agility, Lean, Agile, Kanban e SAFe.


O Scrum Master trabalhará com equipes de entrega ágil para aprimorar e habilitar o desempenho de nível de equipe e entrega de valor usando o Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe).


Duties and Responsibilities:

· Coach de equipes referentes aos valores e princípios lean-agile;

· Facilitar cerimônias ágeis no nível de time (Retrospectiva, Daily Scrum, Sprint Review, Sprint Planning, Refining), garantindo o entendimento e engajamento total da equipe em tais;

· Promover o mindset e práticas de melhoria contínua para as equipes ágeis;

· Integração das melhores práticas e padrões de agilidade em um contexto altamente regulado;

· Fomentar o senso de responsabilidade compartilhada nas equipes e stakeholders;

· Facilitar a resolução de ou impedimentos existentes para os times;

· Gerenciar interdependências entre equipes ágeis;

· Trabalhar com Product Owners para apoiar o planejamento de Curto Prazo e evolução da definição/priorização do Backlog de produto do time;

· Proteger as equipes de interferências externas que possam impactar princípios de agilidade, produtividade da equipe e/ou estágio de formação da equipe;

· Participar e auxiliar na facilitação de todas as cerimônias em um ambiente ágil escalado (SAFe Essential);


Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

· Experiência comprovada como Scrum Master/Agile Master (conhecimento será testado);

· Experiência em ambiente regido pelas cerimônias do SAFe

· Vivência de TI em projetos de desenvolvimento de soluções complexas e de alta disponibilidade

· Experiência com diferentes modelos, métricas e cerimônias no nível de equipe ágil

· Experiência com ferramentas de gerenciamento de trabalho ágil (Jira), incluindo configuração, planejamento e relatórios

· Capacidade promover agilidade em diferentes cenários sendo responsável por garantir que as equipes entendam e operem de acordo com os valores e princípios de agilidade

· Conhecimento em outros métodos e práticas ágeis além do Scrum

Minimum Education:

· Bachelor’s Degree

Required Certifications:

· Possuir certificação KMP, PSPM e MGT 3.0

· Possuir certificação SAFe (plus)


Other:

· English (plus)

O Scrum Master trabalhará com equipes de entrega ágil para aprimorar e habilitar o desempenho de nível de equipe e entrega de valor usando o Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe).


Duties and Responsibilities:

· Coach de equipes referentes aos valores e princípios lean-agile;

· Facilitar cerimônias ágeis no nível de time (Retrospectiva, Daily Scrum, Sprint Review, Sprint Planning, Refining), garantindo o entendimento e engajamento total da equipe em tais;

· Promover o mindset e práticas de melhoria contínua para as equipes ágeis;

· Integração das melhores práticas e padrões de agilidade em um contexto altamente regulado;

· Fomentar o senso de responsabilidade compartilhada nas equipes e stakeholders;

· Facilitar a resolução de ou impedimentos existentes para os times;

· Gerenciar interdependências entre equipes ágeis;

· Trabalhar com Product Owners para apoiar o planejamento de Curto Prazo e evolução da definição/priorização do Backlog de produto do time;

· Proteger as equipes de interferências externas que possam impactar princípios de agilidade, produtividade da equipe e/ou estágio de formação da equipe;

· Participar e auxiliar na facilitação de todas as cerimônias em um ambiente ágil escalado (SAFe Essential);

title: Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial - Motrice - Soluções ESG
description:
A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.

O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses, promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado, ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.

Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico, favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico. A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências, e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável.


Sobre a Oportunidade:


A Motrice é uma empresa especializada em soluções agroindustriais inovadoras e agregadoras de valor para gestão ambiental e economia circular, com percepção e foco no potencial de também transformar resíduos orgânicos urbanos em produtos de alto valor agregado. Utilizando tecnologias limpas e processos acelerados, a empresa desenvolverá sistemas capazes de converter resíduos em fertilizantes e regeneradores de solo de forma muito mais rápida e eficiente do que a compostagem tradicional, além de oferecer alternativas economicamente mais viáveis que o envio para aterros sanitários. Sua atuação integra princípios ESG, promovendo redução de impactos ambientais, reaproveitamento inteligente de resíduos e apoio à regeneração dos solos, contribuindo diretamente para cidades mais sustentáveis e cadeias produtivas de baixo carbono. A Motrice possui em Curitiba uma Planta Piloto equipada para dar pleno suporte ao desenvolvimento do projeto.


Projeto: Soluções ESG.


Formação Acadêmica:


Doutorado completo em Bioengenharia, Bioinformática, Bioquímica , Biologia , Engenharia de Processos, Engenharia Química, Agronomia ou áreas correlatas

Defesa da tese há, no máximo, 5 anos.


Principais Atividades:

  • Desenvolvimento, testes e validação da engenharia de processos, utilizando conhecimentos de física, química e biologia;
  • Estruturar indicadores técnicos e econômicos, mapear possibilidades de escalabilidade e apoiar estratégias de inclusão de catadores, educação ambiental e redesenho de arranjos produtivos locais.


Requisitos Técnicos Mínimos

  • Desenvolvimento de processos físico, químico e biológicos, avaliação agronômica, gestão de resíduos sólidos urbanos, inclusão produtiva


Requisitos Técnicos Desejáveis / Diferenciais

  • Design de experimentos (DOE), modelagem de processos, análise de ciclo de vida (ACV), arranjos produtivos locais (APL), capacitação técnica e integração social


Valor da bolsa (mensal) : Bolsista (Doutor) R$ 5.000 – Programa Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial

Formato de trabalho : Híbrido – Curitiba/PR (integração e sempre que houver atividade de laboratório)

Soft Skills : Liderança, Autonomia, Pensamento Crítico, Ética e Responsabilidade.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
We're Hiring: Senior Data Engineer | Remote from Brazil | Fluent English required |


Location : Remote – Brazil only

Contact: PJ - Long Term


Are you passionate about building scalable data platforms and cutting-edge MLOps solutions? Do you want to work with a top-tier US company revolutionizing e-commerce and circular fashion?

We're looking for a Senior Data Engineer with strong MLOps expertise to join our growing data engineering team. This is a full-time , 100% remote opportunity exclusive to candidates located in Brazil . You'll be working with a fast-paced US-based company, leading innovations in sustainable commerce and data-driven operations.


What You’ll Do


  • Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable data infrastructure across real-time and batch workloads.
  • Build and support ML pipelines for model training, deployment, and monitoring.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with data scientists, engineers, and product teams to deliver high-performance data and ML solutions.
  • Develop APIs and services for data ingestion, transformation, and querying.
  • Ensure the reliability of ML systems through strong observability and operational tools.
  • Contribute to architectural decisions and mentor team members.


Tech Stack & Requirements


  • 5+ years as a Data Engineer or MLOps Engineer.
  • Strong experience with Python , Java , or Scala .
  • Hands-on with GCP (preferred), AWS or Azure .
  • Experience with BigQuery , ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch), and container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with Apache Kafka , Spark , or similar tools is a big plus.
  • Experience with ETL , CI/CD , git , and monitoring pipelines .
  • Strong communication skills and fluency in English (written & spoken) is mandatory .
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or related fields.


What We Offer


  • Top-tier hourly rate paid in USD
  • Long-term contract opportunity
  • Fully remote work – collaborate with international teams from the comfort of your home
  • A high-impact role within a data-driven, mission-oriented company

title: Desenvolvedor SAP ABAP Fiori
description:
Desenvolvedor Sênior ABAP / Fiori

Local: 100% remoto

Regime: PJ ou Coop

Nível: Sênior


Sobre a posição

Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor Sênior ABAP / Fiori para atuar em projetos estratégicos de modernização e evolução tecnológica no ecossistema SAP S/4HANA e SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform) .

O profissional será responsável por desenvolver soluções modernas utilizando ABAP Cloud e RAP (Restful ABAP Programming Model) integradas a SAP Fiori / UI5 , aplicando boas práticas de clean core e arquitetura extensível.

Além das iniciativas mais modernas, é importante que o profissional possua base sólida em ABAP Clássico , garantindo flexibilidade para atuar em demandas tradicionais quando necessário.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver aplicações e extensões com ABAP Cloud / RAP integradas a SAP Fiori / UI5 .
  • Implementar e manter serviços OData, CDS Views e AMDPs para consumo em interfaces Fiori.
  • Trabalhar em ambiente SAP S/4HANA e SAP BTP , aplicando conceitos de clean core e extensibilidade .
  • Apoiar arquitetos e consultores funcionais na definição e entrega de soluções técnicas.
  • Garantir performance, segurança e qualidade de código nas entregas.
  • Contribuir com revisões de código, boas práticas e mentoria técnica para o time.
  • Atuar também, quando necessário, em demandas ABAP Clássico , mantendo soluções legadas e promovendo sua evolução gradativa para o novo modelo.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • 5+ anos de experiência em desenvolvimento ABAP , com domínio de ABAP Clássico e ABAP Cloud .
  • Experiência sólida com RAP (Restful ABAP Programming Model) .
  • Domínio de SAP Fiori / SAP UI5 e Fiori Elements .
  • Conhecimento em CDS Views , OData Services , AMDPs e integrações RESTful .
  • Experiência com SAP S/4HANA e ferramentas modernas de desenvolvimento (Eclipse ADT, Git, transportes em BTP ).
  • Boa capacidade de comunicação e trabalho colaborativo em times ágeis.


Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento em CAP (Cloud Application Programming Model) .
  • Experiência com SAP BTP , extensões side-by-side e integrações em nuvem.
  • Certificação SAP ABAP for Cloud ou SAP BTP.
  • Experiência em S/4HANA Cloud (Public ou Private Edition) .

Desenvolvimento e Manutenção dos componentes do framework de desenvolvimento concebido pela companhia e utilizado no sistema SINACOR.

Evolução arquitetural dos produtos.

Suporte aos times de implantação e desenvolvimento.

MBA ou pós-graduação relacionados a arquitetura de SW.

Foco no Resultado, orientação para o cliente e construção de relacionamentos e trabalho em equipe.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
We're Hiring: Senior Data Engineer | Remote from Brazil | Fluent English required |


Location : Remote – Brazil only

Contact: PJ - Long Term


Are you passionate about building scalable data platforms and cutting-edge MLOps solutions? Do you want to work with a top-tier US company revolutionizing e-commerce and circular fashion?

We're looking for a Senior Data Engineer with strong MLOps expertise to join our growing data engineering team. This is a full-time , 100% remote opportunity exclusive to candidates located in Brazil . You'll be working with a fast-paced US-based company, leading innovations in sustainable commerce and data-driven operations.

  • Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable data infrastructure across real-time and batch workloads.

  • Familiarity with Apache Kafka , Spark , or similar tools is a big plus.
  • Experience with ETL , CI/CD , git , and monitoring pipelines .
  • Strong communication skills and fluency in English (written & spoken) is mandatory .
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or related fields.


What We Offer


  • Top-tier hourly rate paid in USD
  • Long-term contract opportunity
  • Fully remote work – collaborate with international teams from the comfort of your home
  • A high-impact role within a data-driven, mission-oriented company

title: Python/Cloud Platform Developer
description:
Python/Cloud Platform Developer


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


We seek an experienced high-performing Python engineer for a position supporting and developing new tools and processes to be used on an on-prem private cloud application. Your role will involve to communicate technical concepts clearly, facilitate discussions, collaborate with stakeholders, provide project updates and mentor team members.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Develop high performance cloud and container technologies mostly leveraging Python as the main programming language;
  • Develop and deliver high quality solutions and code;
  • Develop unit tests, improving the SDLC;
  • Investigate and resolve issues reported during testing and customer integration;
  • Actively participate in all aspects of an agile software development process;
  • Work as part of a team focused on containerization, virtualization and fault tolerant/carrier grade development;
  • Contribute to a highly available orchestration platform used to deploy private cloud platform aimed to be at the core of 5G and distributed Edge deployments worldwide.

Essential Skills


  • Solid backend developer (preferably but not restricted to Python), knowledgeable in Linux Essentials:
  • Medium knowledge in concepts of hardware, processes, programs and the components of the Linux Operating System;
  • How to work on the command line and with files;
  • How to create and restore compressed backups and archives;
  • System security: users/groups and file permissions for public and private directories;
  • How to create and run simple scripts;
  • Interested in working on development and troubleshooting of a highly distributed orchestration platform supporting multiple vendors;
  • Strong computer networking knowledge and transport (TCP/UDP/etc.) layers;
  • Knowledge of cloud computing concepts;
  • Experience collaborating effectively across remote teams and time zones, and collaborating with Senior Technical Leaders;
  • Experience with GIT, Jira, Gitlab and code review tools;
  • Experience with container technologies (e.g., Docker, Linux Containers, etc.);
  • Experience with Kubernetes Cluster Administration (design infrastructure that involves one or more Kubernetes clusters, configure, control, and monitor Kubernetes clusters);
  • Experience with Docker;
  • Experience with Helm.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Experience with Kubernetes App Development (design and development of applications that run in Kubernetes clusters);
  • Experience with PostgreSQL as a developer;
  • Experience with RabbitMQ as a developer.

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Atendimento ao cliente
description:
VAGA | ESPECIALISTA DE QUALIDADE – EXPERIÊNCIA DO ASSOCIADO & EXCELÊNCIA OPERACIONAL


Você acredita que qualidade vai além de processos e começa na escuta ativa, no cuidado com as pessoas e na busca constante pela excelência?

Então essa vaga é para você.


Estamos em busca de um(a) Especialista de Qualidade para atuar de forma estratégica no tratamento de feedbacks, análise de reclamações e melhoria contínua da experiência do associado em uma Associação de Proteção Veicular.


Aqui, sua missão será transformar feedbacks em ações práticas, fortalecendo a confiança, a credibilidade e a excelência no atendimento.


Missão da função


Garantir a excelência na experiência do associado, atuando na coleta, análise e tratamento de feedbacks e reclamações, com postura técnica, empática e orientada a soluções, sempre alinhado(a) aos padrões de qualidade e às diretrizes internas.


Principais responsabilidades


Coletar, analisar e consolidar feedbacks de associados


Tratar reclamações, manifestações e insatisfações, buscando solução e encantamento


Atuar de forma preventiva na identificação de falhas de processo


Elaborar relatórios de qualidade, indicadores e pontos de melhoria


Apoiar as áreas internas na correção de desvios e padronização de processos


Garantir o cumprimento dos padrões de qualidade, atendimento e prazos


Atuar com foco em excelência, empatia e resolução


Perfil que buscamos


Ensino médio completo (desejável superior em andamento ou concluído)


Comunicação clara, empática e profissional


Perfil analítico, organizado e orientado a processos


Capacidade de lidar com reclamações de forma técnica e humanizada


Facilidade com sistemas, planilhas e indicadores


Diferenciais:


Experiência com Qualidade, Ouvidoria, SAC, Reclame Aqui ou Pós-venda


Vivência em proteção veicular, seguradora ou serviços


Conhecimento em ISO 9001, NPS, indicadores de qualidade e melhoria contínua


Condições da vaga


Salário: R$ 2.164,00


Vale Refeição: R$ 35,00 por dia


Vale Alimentação: R$ 165,00 mensal


Vale Transporte


Day Off


TotalPass


Plano de Saúde (após período de experiência)


Plano de Carreira estruturado


Horário de trabalho


Segunda a sexta: das 8h40 às 18h


Sábados alternados: das 9h às 13h


Por que essa vaga é diferente?


Aqui você terá:


Autonomia para atuar com qualidade e impacto real


Espaço para propor melhorias e evoluir processos


Reconhecimento por resultados e excelência


Ambiente colaborativo e orientado ao desenvolvimento


Se você acredita que excelência se constrói com escuta, ação e melhoria contínua, venha fazer parte do nosso time.


Envie seu currículo e venha elevar o padrão de qualidade com a gente!

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
We're Hiring: Senior Data Engineer | Remote from Brazil | Fluent English required |


Location : Remote – Brazil only

Contact: PJ - Long Term


Are you passionate about building scalable data platforms and cutting-edge MLOps solutions? Do you want to work with a top-tier US company revolutionizing e-commerce and circular fashion?

We're looking for a Senior Data Engineer with strong MLOps expertise to join our growing data engineering team. This is a full-time , 100% remote opportunity exclusive to candidates located in Brazil . You'll be working with a fast-paced US-based company, leading innovations in sustainable commerce and data-driven operations.


What You’ll Do


  • Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable data infrastructure across real-time and batch workloads.
  • Build and support ML pipelines for model training, deployment, and monitoring.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with data scientists, engineers, and product teams to deliver high-performance data and ML solutions.
  • Develop APIs and services for data ingestion, transformation, and querying.
  • Ensure the reliability of ML systems through strong observability and operational tools.
  • Contribute to architectural decisions and mentor team members.


Tech Stack & Requirements


  • 5+ years as a Data Engineer or MLOps Engineer.
  • Strong experience with Python , Java , or Scala .
  • Hands-on with GCP (preferred), AWS or Azure .
  • Experience with BigQuery , ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch), and container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with Apache Kafka , Spark , or similar tools is a big plus.
  • Experience with ETL , CI/CD , git , and monitoring pipelines .
  • Strong communication skills and fluency in English (written & spoken) is mandatory .
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or related fields.


What We Offer


  • Top-tier hourly rate paid in USD
  • Long-term contract opportunity
  • Fully remote work – collaborate with international teams from the comfort of your home
  • A high-impact role within a data-driven, mission-oriented company

title: Desenvolvedor SAP ABAP Fiori
description:

Local: 100% remoto

Regime: PJ ou Coop

Nível: Sênior


Sobre a posição

Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor Sênior ABAP / Fiori para atuar em projetos estratégicos de modernização e evolução tecnológica no ecossistema SAP S/4HANA e SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform) .

O profissional será responsável por desenvolver soluções modernas utilizando ABAP Cloud e RAP (Restful ABAP Programming Model) integradas a SAP Fiori / UI5 , aplicando boas práticas de clean core e arquitetura extensível.

Além das iniciativas mais modernas, é importante que o profissional possua base sólida em ABAP Clássico , garantindo flexibilidade para atuar em demandas tradicionais quando necessário.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver aplicações e extensões com ABAP Cloud / RAP integradas a SAP Fiori / UI5 .
  • Implementar e manter serviços OData, CDS Views e AMDPs para consumo em interfaces Fiori.
  • Trabalhar em ambiente SAP S/4HANA e SAP BTP , aplicando conceitos de clean core e extensibilidade .
  • Apoiar arquitetos e consultores funcionais na definição e entrega de soluções técnicas.
  • Garantir performance, segurança e qualidade de código nas entregas.
  • Contribuir com revisões de código, boas práticas e mentoria técnica para o time.
  • Atuar também, quando necessário, em demandas ABAP Clássico , mantendo soluções legadas e promovendo sua evolução gradativa para o novo modelo.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • 5+ anos de experiência em desenvolvimento ABAP , com domínio de ABAP Clássico e ABAP Cloud .
  • Experiência sólida com RAP (Restful ABAP Programming Model) .
  • Domínio de SAP Fiori / SAP UI5 e Fiori Elements .
  • Conhecimento em CDS Views , OData Services , AMDPs e integrações RESTful .
  • Experiência com SAP S/4HANA e ferramentas modernas de desenvolvimento (Eclipse ADT, Git, transportes em BTP ).
  • Boa capacidade de comunicação e trabalho colaborativo em times ágeis.


Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento em CAP (Cloud Application Programming Model) .
  • Experiência com SAP BTP , extensões side-by-side e integrações em nuvem.
  • Certificação SAP ABAP for Cloud ou SAP BTP.
  • Experiência em S/4HANA Cloud (Public ou Private Edition) .

title: Bilingual Civil Engineer (Load analysis: Structural conditions of rooftops/framing systems)
description:
The Company

Datamtx ( / formerly Datamatics) established in 1993 and globally HQ'd in Atlanta has a stellar history supporting both Tier 1 and 2 Manufacturing ERP rollouts ranging from implementations, data cleanse, migrations, customization, hypercare and Day 1 support. We are also nationally aligned with leading accounting firms & VARs.

Our ERP / CRM coverage includes: SAP, Oracle EBS/Fusion, Oracle Cloud ERP, Peoplesoft, JDE, Infor (M3, LX, XA, LN, System 21), IFS, Epicor, SysPro, D365 & Salesforce.

One of our longest standing service verticals has been assisting transition clients from legacy systems to cloud based platforms including introduction of Cloud / GenAI and MS-Fabric, RAG models.


We are seeking a multiple Civil Engineers with emphasis on Load analysis: Structural conditions of rooftops/framing systems.

English language proficiency is mandatory.


These are remote roles.


This is a Civil Engineering client who are a market leader in the renewable energy industry. Ideally, they would like to start someone by early February for 11 months with an option to extend annually.

ROLES:

1) Civil Engineers (3+ years of experience)

2) Associate Civil Engineer: ACE (0-3 years of experience)


Executive Summary

Our client is dedicated to maintaining high-volume production speeds without compromising the rigorous structural safety and code compliance standards required for a 25-year system life. We require a scalable solution where a vendor-managed team can execute technical reviews, resolve engineering escalations, and maintain seamless communication across our design-to-installation pipeline.


Primary Duties

  • Reviewing structural conditions of rooftops and framing systems
  • Designing or verifying the configuration of racking and attachment systems
  • Performing load analysis to ensure compliance with applicable safety standards and expected performance over a 25-year system life
  • Working in a high-volume production environment, completing multiple project assessments per day, with some engineers averaging multiple evaluations per hour
  • The ability to maintain accuracy and consistency at scale is critical.
  • Regular shifting of work schedule may be required to support seasonal business needs
  • Turnaround Times: Core tasks are measured in business hours with expectations ranging from 4 to 24 hours depending on the task type.
  • Quality & Accountability: Staff must maintain a 95% quality score ; consistent failure to meet these standards requires a Performance Improvement Plan within 10 business days.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in an engineering discipline, with preference for civil or structural engineering
  • Professional accreditation or licensure in their home country (preferred but not mandatory)
  • Proficiency in technical analysis and structural design tools is a plus but not required
  • Strong English communication skills for coordination with US-based engineering leads


Experience level

  • Associate Civil Engineer-ACE: 0–3 years of relevant experience, ideal for early-career engineers seeking growth in a specialized field
  • Civil Engineer: 3+ years of relevant experience, ideal for early-career engineers seeking growth in a specialized field

title: Python/Cloud Platform Developer
description:
Python/Cloud Platform Developer


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


We seek an experienced high-performing Python engineer for a position supporting and developing new tools and processes to be used on an on-prem private cloud application. Your role will involve to communicate technical concepts clearly, facilitate discussions, collaborate with stakeholders, provide project updates and mentor team members.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Develop high performance cloud and container technologies mostly leveraging Python as the main programming language;
  • Develop and deliver high quality solutions and code;
  • Develop unit tests, improving the SDLC;
  • Investigate and resolve issues reported during testing and customer integration;
  • Actively participate in all aspects of an agile software development process;
  • Work as part of a team focused on containerization, virtualization and fault tolerant/carrier grade development;
  • Contribute to a highly available orchestration platform used to deploy private cloud platform aimed to be at the core of 5G and distributed Edge deployments worldwide.

Essential Skills


  • Solid backend developer (preferably but not restricted to Python), knowledgeable in Linux Essentials:
  • Medium knowledge in concepts of hardware, processes, programs and the components of the Linux Operating System;
  • How to work on the command line and with files;
  • How to create and restore compressed backups and archives;
  • System security: users/groups and file permissions for public and private directories;
  • How to create and run simple scripts;
  • Interested in working on development and troubleshooting of a highly distributed orchestration platform supporting multiple vendors;
  • Strong computer networking knowledge and transport (TCP/UDP/etc.) layers;
  • Knowledge of cloud computing concepts;
  • Experience collaborating effectively across remote teams and time zones, and collaborating with Senior Technical Leaders;
  • Experience with GIT, Jira, Gitlab and code review tools;
  • Experience with container technologies (e.g., Docker, Linux Containers, etc.);
  • Experience with Kubernetes Cluster Administration (design infrastructure that involves one or more Kubernetes clusters, configure, control, and monitor Kubernetes clusters);
  • Experience with Docker;
  • Experience with Helm.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Experience with Kubernetes App Development (design and development of applications that run in Kubernetes clusters);
  • Experience with PostgreSQL as a developer;
  • Experience with RabbitMQ as a developer.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
We're Hiring: Senior Data Engineer | Remote from Brazil | Fluent English required |


Location : Remote – Brazil only

Contact: PJ - Long Term


Are you passionate about building scalable data platforms and cutting-edge MLOps solutions? Do you want to work with a top-tier US company revolutionizing e-commerce and circular fashion?

We're looking for a Senior Data Engineer with strong MLOps expertise to join our growing data engineering team. This is a full-time , 100% remote opportunity exclusive to candidates located in Brazil . You'll be working with a fast-paced US-based company, leading innovations in sustainable commerce and data-driven operations.


What You’ll Do


  • Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable data infrastructure across real-time and batch workloads.
  • Build and support ML pipelines for model training, deployment, and monitoring.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with data scientists, engineers, and product teams to deliver high-performance data and ML solutions.
  • Develop APIs and services for data ingestion, transformation, and querying.
  • Ensure the reliability of ML systems through strong observability and operational tools.
  • Contribute to architectural decisions and mentor team members.


Tech Stack & Requirements


  • 5+ years as a Data Engineer or MLOps Engineer.
  • Strong experience with Python , Java , or Scala .
  • Hands-on with GCP (preferred), AWS or Azure .
  • Experience with BigQuery , ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch), and container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with Apache Kafka , Spark , or similar tools is a big plus.
  • Experience with ETL , CI/CD , git , and monitoring pipelines .
  • Strong communication skills and fluency in English (written & spoken) is mandatory .
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or related fields.


What We Offer


  • Top-tier hourly rate paid in USD
  • Long-term contract opportunity
  • Fully remote work – collaborate with international teams from the comfort of your home
  • A high-impact role within a data-driven, mission-oriented company

title: Desenvolvedor SAP ABAP Fiori
description:
Desenvolvedor Sênior ABAP / Fiori

Local: 100% remoto

Regime: PJ ou Coop

Nível: Sênior


Sobre a posição

Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor Sênior ABAP / Fiori para atuar em projetos estratégicos de modernização e evolução tecnológica no ecossistema SAP S/4HANA e SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform) .

O profissional será responsável por desenvolver soluções modernas utilizando ABAP Cloud e RAP (Restful ABAP Programming Model) integradas a SAP Fiori / UI5 , aplicando boas práticas de clean core e arquitetura extensível.

Além das iniciativas mais modernas, é importante que o profissional possua base sólida em ABAP Clássico , garantindo flexibilidade para atuar em demandas tradicionais quando necessário.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver aplicações e extensões com ABAP Cloud / RAP integradas a SAP Fiori / UI5 .
  • Implementar e manter serviços OData, CDS Views e AMDPs para consumo em interfaces Fiori.
  • Trabalhar em ambiente SAP S/4HANA e SAP BTP , aplicando conceitos de clean core e extensibilidade .

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
We're Hiring: Senior Data Engineer | Remote from Brazil | Fluent English required |


Location : Remote – Brazil only

Contact: PJ - Long Term


Are you passionate about building scalable data platforms and cutting-edge MLOps solutions? Do you want to work with a top-tier US company revolutionizing e-commerce and circular fashion?

We're looking for a Senior Data Engineer with strong MLOps expertise to join our growing data engineering team. This is a full-time , 100% remote opportunity exclusive to candidates located in Brazil . You'll be working with a fast-paced US-based company, leading innovations in sustainable commerce and data-driven operations.


What You’ll Do


  • Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable data infrastructure across real-time and batch workloads.
  • Build and support ML pipelines for model training, deployment, and monitoring.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with data scientists, engineers, and product teams to deliver high-performance data and ML solutions.
  • Develop APIs and services for data ingestion, transformation, and querying.
  • Ensure the reliability of ML systems through strong observability and operational tools.
  • Contribute to architectural decisions and mentor team members.


Tech Stack & Requirements


  • 5+ years as a Data Engineer or MLOps Engineer.
  • Strong experience with Python , Java , or Scala .
  • Hands-on with GCP (preferred), AWS or Azure .
  • Experience with BigQuery , ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch), and container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with Apache Kafka , Spark , or similar tools is a big plus.
  • Experience with ETL , CI/CD , git , and monitoring pipelines .
  • Strong communication skills and fluency in English (written & spoken) is mandatory .
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or related fields.


What We Offer


  • Top-tier hourly rate paid in USD
  • Long-term contract opportunity
  • Fully remote work – collaborate with international teams from the comfort of your home
  • A high-impact role within a data-driven, mission-oriented company

title: Bilingual Civil Engineer (Load analysis: Structural conditions of rooftops/framing systems)
description:
The Company

Datamtx ( / formerly Datamatics) established in 1993 and globally HQ'd in Atlanta has a stellar history supporting both Tier 1 and 2 Manufacturing ERP rollouts ranging from implementations, data cleanse, migrations, customization, hypercare and Day 1 support. We are also nationally aligned with leading accounting firms & VARs.

Our ERP / CRM coverage includes: SAP, Oracle EBS/Fusion, Oracle Cloud ERP, Peoplesoft, JDE, Infor (M3, LX, XA, LN, System 21), IFS, Epicor, SysPro, D365 & Salesforce.

One of our longest standing service verticals has been assisting transition clients from legacy systems to cloud based platforms including introduction of Cloud / GenAI and MS-Fabric, RAG models.


We are seeking a multiple Civil Engineers with emphasis on Load analysis: Structural conditions of rooftops/framing systems.

English language proficiency is mandatory.


These are remote roles.


This is a Civil Engineering client who are a market leader in the renewable energy industry. Ideally, they would like to start someone by early February for 11 months with an option to extend annually.

ROLES:

1) Civil Engineers (3+ years of experience)

2) Associate Civil Engineer: ACE (0-3 years of experience)


Executive Summary

Our client is dedicated to maintaining high-volume production speeds without compromising the rigorous structural safety and code compliance standards required for a 25-year system life. We require a scalable solution where a vendor-managed team can execute technical reviews, resolve engineering escalations, and maintain seamless communication across our design-to-installation pipeline.


Primary Duties

  • Reviewing structural conditions of rooftops and framing systems
  • Designing or verifying the configuration of racking and attachment systems
  • Performing load analysis to ensure compliance with applicable safety standards and expected performance over a 25-year system life
  • Working in a high-volume production environment, completing multiple project assessments per day, with some engineers averaging multiple evaluations per hour
  • The ability to maintain accuracy and consistency at scale is critical.
  • Regular shifting of work schedule may be required to support seasonal business needs
  • Turnaround Times: Core tasks are measured in business hours with expectations ranging from 4 to 24 hours depending on the task type.
  • Quality & Accountability: Staff must maintain a 95% quality score ; consistent failure to meet these standards requires a Performance Improvement Plan within 10 business days.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in an engineering discipline, with preference for civil or structural engineering
  • Professional accreditation or licensure in their home country (preferred but not mandatory)
  • Proficiency in technical analysis and structural design tools is a plus but not required
  • Strong English communication skills for coordination with US-based engineering leads


Experience level

  • Associate Civil Engineer-ACE: 0–3 years of relevant experience, ideal for early-career engineers seeking growth in a specialized field
  • Civil Engineer: 3+ years of relevant experience, ideal for early-career engineers seeking growth in a specialized field

title: Python/Cloud Platform Developer
description:
Python/Cloud Platform Developer


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


We seek an experienced high-performing Python engineer for a position supporting and developing new tools and processes to be used on an on-prem private cloud application. Your role will involve to communicate technical concepts clearly, facilitate discussions, collaborate with stakeholders, provide project updates and mentor team members.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Develop high performance cloud and container technologies mostly leveraging Python as the main programming language;
  • Develop and deliver high quality solutions and code;
  • Develop unit tests, improving the SDLC;
  • Investigate and resolve issues reported during testing and customer integration;
  • Actively participate in all aspects of an agile software development process;
  • Work as part of a team focused on containerization, virtualization and fault tolerant/carrier grade development;
  • Contribute to a highly available orchestration platform used to deploy private cloud platform aimed to be at the core of 5G and distributed Edge deployments worldwide.

Essential Skills


  • Solid backend developer (preferably but not restricted to Python), knowledgeable in Linux Essentials:
  • Medium knowledge in concepts of hardware, processes, programs and the components of the Linux Operating System;
  • How to work on the command line and with files;
  • How to create and restore compressed backups and archives;
  • System security: users/groups and file permissions for public and private directories;
  • How to create and run simple scripts;
  • Interested in working on development and troubleshooting of a highly distributed orchestration platform supporting multiple vendors;
  • Strong computer networking knowledge and transport (TCP/UDP/etc.) layers;
  • Knowledge of cloud computing concepts;
  • Experience collaborating effectively across remote teams and time zones, and collaborating with Senior Technical Leaders;
  • Experience with GIT, Jira, Gitlab and code review tools;
  • Experience with container technologies (e.g., Docker, Linux Containers, etc.);
  • Experience with Kubernetes Cluster Administration (design infrastructure that involves one or more Kubernetes clusters, configure, control, and monitor Kubernetes clusters);
  • Experience with Docker;
  • Experience with Helm.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Experience with Kubernetes App Development (design and development of applications that run in Kubernetes clusters);
  • Experience with PostgreSQL as a developer;
  • Experience with RabbitMQ as a developer.

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
We're Hiring: Senior Data Engineer | Remote from Brazil | Fluent English required |


Location : Remote – Brazil only

Contact: PJ - Long Term


Are you passionate about building scalable data platforms and cutting-edge MLOps solutions? Do you want to work with a top-tier US company revolutionizing e-commerce and circular fashion?

We're looking for a Senior Data Engineer with strong MLOps expertise to join our growing data engineering team. This is a full-time , 100% remote opportunity exclusive to candidates located in Brazil . You'll be working with a fast-paced US-based company, leading innovations in sustainable commerce and data-driven operations.


What You’ll Do


  • Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable data infrastructure across real-time and batch workloads.
  • Build and support ML pipelines for model training, deployment, and monitoring.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with data scientists, engineers, and product teams to deliver high-performance data and ML solutions.
  • Develop APIs and services for data ingestion, transformation, and querying.
  • Ensure the reliability of ML systems through strong observability and operational tools.
  • Contribute to architectural decisions and mentor team members.


Tech Stack & Requirements


  • 5+ years as a Data Engineer or MLOps Engineer.
  • Strong experience with Python , Java , or Scala .
  • Hands-on with GCP (preferred), AWS or Azure .
  • Experience with BigQuery , ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch), and container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with Apache Kafka , Spark , or similar tools is a big plus.
  • Experience with ETL , CI/CD , git , and monitoring pipelines .
  • Strong communication skills and fluency in English (written & spoken) is mandatory .
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or related fields.


What We Offer


  • Top-tier hourly rate paid in USD
  • Long-term contract opportunity
  • Fully remote work – collaborate with international teams from the comfort of your home
  • A high-impact role within a data-driven, mission-oriented company

title: Desenvolvedor SAP ABAP Fiori
description:
Desenvolvedor Sênior ABAP / Fiori

Local: 100% remoto

Regime: PJ ou Coop

Nível: Sênior


Sobre a posição

Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor Sênior ABAP / Fiori para atuar em projetos estratégicos de modernização e evolução tecnológica no ecossistema SAP S/4HANA e SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform) .

O profissional será responsável por desenvolver soluções modernas utilizando ABAP Cloud e RAP (Restful ABAP Programming Model) integradas a SAP Fiori / UI5 , aplicando boas práticas de clean core e arquitetura extensível.

Além das iniciativas mais modernas, é importante que o profissional possua base sólida em ABAP Clássico , garantindo flexibilidade para atuar em demandas tradicionais quando necessário.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver aplicações e extensões com ABAP Cloud / RAP integradas a SAP Fiori / UI5 .
  • Implementar e manter serviços OData, CDS Views e AMDPs para consumo em interfaces Fiori.
  • Trabalhar em ambiente SAP S/4HANA e SAP BTP , aplicando conceitos de clean core e extensibilidade .
  • Apoiar arquitetos e consultores funcionais na definição e entrega de soluções técnicas.
  • Garantir performance, segurança e qualidade de código nas entregas.
  • Contribuir com revisões de código, boas práticas e mentoria técnica para o time.
  • Atuar também, quando necessário, em demandas ABAP Clássico , mantendo soluções legadas e promovendo sua evolução gradativa para o novo modelo.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • 5+ anos de experiência em desenvolvimento ABAP , com domínio de ABAP Clássico e ABAP Cloud .
  • Experiência sólida com RAP (Restful ABAP Programming Model) .
  • Domínio de SAP Fiori / SAP UI5 e Fiori Elements .
  • Conhecimento em CDS Views , OData Services , AMDPs e integrações RESTful .
  • Experiência com SAP S/4HANA e ferramentas modernas de desenvolvimento (Eclipse ADT, Git, transportes em BTP ).
  • Boa capacidade de comunicação e trabalho colaborativo em times ágeis.


Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento em CAP (Cloud Application Programming Model) .
  • Experiência com SAP BTP , extensões side-by-side e integrações em nuvem.
  • Certificação SAP ABAP for Cloud ou SAP BTP.
  • Experiência em S/4HANA Cloud (Public ou Private Edition) .

title: Bilingual Civil Engineer (Load analysis: Structural conditions of rooftops/framing systems)
description:
The Company

Datamtx ( / formerly Datamatics) established in 1993 and globally HQ'd in Atlanta has a stellar history supporting both Tier 1 and 2 Manufacturing ERP rollouts ranging from implementations, data cleanse, migrations, customization, hypercare and Day 1 support. We are also nationally aligned with leading accounting firms & VARs.

Our ERP / CRM coverage includes: SAP, Oracle EBS/Fusion, Oracle Cloud ERP, Peoplesoft, JDE, Infor (M3, LX, XA, LN, System 21), IFS, Epicor, SysPro, D365 & Salesforce.

One of our longest standing service verticals has been assisting transition clients from legacy systems to cloud based platforms including introduction of Cloud / GenAI and MS-Fabric, RAG models.


We are seeking a multiple Civil Engineers with emphasis on Load analysis: Structural conditions of rooftops/framing systems.

English language proficiency is mandatory.


These are remote roles.


This is a Civil Engineering client who are a market leader in the renewable energy industry. Ideally, they would like to start someone by early February for 11 months with an option to extend annually.

ROLES:

1) Civil Engineers (3+ years of experience)

2) Associate Civil Engineer: ACE (0-3 years of experience)


Executive Summary

Our client is dedicated to maintaining high-volume production speeds without compromising the rigorous structural safety and code compliance standards required for a 25-year system life. We require a scalable solution where a vendor-managed team can execute technical reviews, resolve engineering escalations, and maintain seamless communication across our design-to-installation pipeline.


Primary Duties

  • Reviewing structural conditions of rooftops and framing systems
  • Designing or verifying the configuration of racking and attachment systems
  • Performing load analysis to ensure compliance with applicable safety standards and expected performance over a 25-year system life
  • Working in a high-volume production environment, completing multiple project assessments per day, with some engineers averaging multiple evaluations per hour
  • The ability to maintain accuracy and consistency at scale is critical.
  • Regular shifting of work schedule may be required to support seasonal business needs
  • Turnaround Times: Core tasks are measured in business hours with expectations ranging from 4 to 24 hours depending on the task type.
  • Quality & Accountability: Staff must maintain a 95% quality score ; consistent failure to meet these standards requires a Performance Improvement Plan within 10 business days.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in an engineering discipline, with preference for civil or structural engineering
  • Professional accreditation or licensure in their home country (preferred but not mandatory)
  • Proficiency in technical analysis and structural design tools is a plus but not required
  • Strong English communication skills for coordination with US-based engineering leads


Experience level

  • Associate Civil Engineer-ACE: 0–3 years of relevant experience, ideal for early-career engineers seeking growth in a specialized field
  • Civil Engineer: 3+ years of relevant experience, ideal for early-career engineers seeking growth in a specialized field

This is a Civil Engineering client who are a market leader in the renewable energy industry. Ideally, they would like to start someone by early February for 11 months with an option to extend annually.

ROLES:

1) Civil Engineers (3+ years of experience)

2) Associate Civil Engineer: ACE (0-3 years of experience)


Executive Summary

Our client is dedicated to maintaining high-volume production speeds without compromising the rigorous structural safety and code compliance standards required for a 25-year system life. We require a scalable solution where a vendor-managed team can execute technical reviews, resolve engineering escalations, and maintain seamless communication across our design-to-installation pipeline.


Primary Duties

  • Reviewing structural conditions of rooftops and framing systems
  • Designing or verifying the configuration of racking and attachment systems
  • Performing load analysis to ensure compliance with applicable safety standards and expected performance over a 25-year system life
  • Working in a high-volume production environment, completing multiple project assessments per day, with some engineers averaging multiple evaluations per hour
  • The ability to maintain accuracy and consistency at scale is critical.
  • Regular shifting of work schedule may be required to support seasonal business needs
  • Turnaround Times: Core tasks are measured in business hours with expectations ranging from 4 to 24 hours depending on the task type.
  • Quality & Accountability: Staff must maintain a 95% quality score ; consistent failure to meet these standards requires a Performance Improvement Plan within 10 business days.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in an engineering discipline, with preference for civil or structural engineering
  • Professional accreditation or licensure in their home country (preferred but not mandatory)
  • Proficiency in technical analysis and structural design tools is a plus but not required
  • Strong English communication skills for coordination with US-based engineering leads


Experience level

  • Associate Civil Engineer-ACE: 0–3 years of relevant experience, ideal for early-career engineers seeking growth in a specialized field
  • Civil Engineer: 3+ years of relevant experience, ideal for early-career engineers seeking growth in a specialized field

title: B2B Sales Account Executive (Education/Schools)
description:
Position name: Partnerships Manager

# K–12 #Education #B2B



*****************************************************************

*MUST HAVE experience in B2B consultative sales for schools*

*****************************************************************



******IMPORTANT******

Qualification: Mid-level 3+ years

English: Fluent

Contract: Contractor (PJ) – full-time

Compensation: Competitive fixed monthly amount + variable commission, aligned with experience.

Location: Hybrid, 3+ days on-site in São Paulo (Zona Sul); availability for nationwide travel (evenings/weekends as needed).

************************



About Us

WorldEd is an established K-12 school and education provider with an international footprint built through long-term partnerships with schools and educational institutions. We support partners with high-quality learning solutions and a delivery model designed for real implementation. As we grow, we’re strengthening our commercial operation with people who execute reliably, building partnerships that are commercially sound and operationally deliverable.


Job Overview

You’ll run end-to-end consultative B2B sales with schools and educational institutions, including outbound prospecting, discovery, proposal, negotiation, and contract signature. You’ll be responsible for closing deals that can be delivered—confirming feasibility and aligning with Academic, Growth, and Customer Success. This role is for someone who takes full ownership: builds pipeline proactively, resolves issues, and steps in when urgent partner or contract matters threaten signature, delivery, or retention.


Commercial Coverage (important): Occasionally, urgent partner or contract matters may arise outside standard working hours (including during breaks). When this happens, you are expected to be reachable, respond promptly, and help drive resolution, especially when a deal is at signature stage or a partner issue risks delivery or retention. This is occasional, not constant, but we take responsibility when something critical must be handled.


Key Responsibilities

  • Own the full-cycle consultative sales process with schools, school groups, and strategic partners—from prospecting to signed contract.
  • Prospect and qualify opportunities (outbound + inbound) aligned to the ICP and sales strategy.
  • Lead structured discovery to understand needs, constraints, stakeholders, and decision process.
  • Build tailored proposals that define scope, assumptions, success criteria, pricing, and timelines.
  • Negotiate and close within commercial policy; escalate exceptions when needed.
  • Manage pipeline, forecasting, and activity cadence with strong CRM hygiene.
  • Align deals with Academic, Product, and Customer Success to ensure feasibility and smooth implementation.
  • Share market insights to improve messaging, playbooks, collateral, and go-to-market decisions.


Qualifications

  • 3+ years in B2B consultative sales (preferably K–12, EdTech, services, or recurring revenue).
  • Proven ability to run multi-stakeholder, longer sales cycles and consistently hit targets.
  • Strong discovery, proposal, negotiation, and closing skills (including objection handling).
  • Highly organized: pipeline management, follow-up discipline, and accurate forecasting.
  • Clear, influential communication with both operational and executive stakeholders.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration and good judgment around risks/feasibility.
  • Comfortable using CRM tools (HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, etc.) with strong data hygiene.
  • Fluent English required; willing to travel.


This role is not for you if… (important)

  • ... you rely on heavy inbound only or avoid outbound prospecting.
  • ... you are comfortable closing deals without confirming delivery feasibility.
  • … you prefer to “hand off” problems instead of owning them through to resolution.
  • … you do only what is explicitly assigned and avoid going the extra mile.
  • … you expect strict boundaries regardless of context and won’t step in when something urgent needs to be resolved.


What We Offer

  • A culture in a constantly growing segment with continuous learning opportunities.
  • Full scholarship for direct dependents in WorldEd's American programs.
  • Total Pass wellness and quality of life benefit.
  • Hybrid work model: 3+ days on-site in São Paulo (Zona Sul); availability for nationwide travel (evenings/weekends as needed).
  • Parking space at our headquarters.
  • Competitive fixed monthly amount + variable commission, aligned with experience.


If you're passionate about helping students succeed through high-quality education, disciplined about pipeline management, strong in discovery and negotiation, and committed to selling deals that can be delivered well, we want to hear from you.

title: Python/Cloud Platform Developer
description:
Python/Cloud Platform Developer


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


We seek an experienced high-performing Python engineer for a position supporting and developing new tools and processes to be used on an on-prem private cloud application. Your role will involve to communicate technical concepts clearly, facilitate discussions, collaborate with stakeholders, provide project updates and mentor team members.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Develop high performance cloud and container technologies mostly leveraging Python as the main programming language;
  • Develop and deliver high quality solutions and code;
  • Develop unit tests, improving the SDLC;
  • Investigate and resolve issues reported during testing and customer integration;
  • Actively participate in all aspects of an agile software development process;
  • Work as part of a team focused on containerization, virtualization and fault tolerant/carrier grade development;
  • Contribute to a highly available orchestration platform used to deploy private cloud platform aimed to be at the core of 5G and distributed Edge deployments worldwide.

Essential Skills


  • Solid backend developer (preferably but not restricted to Python), knowledgeable in Linux Essentials:
  • Medium knowledge in concepts of hardware, processes, programs and the components of the Linux Operating System;
  • How to work on the command line and with files;
  • How to create and restore compressed backups and archives;
  • System security: users/groups and file permissions for public and private directories;
  • How to create and run simple scripts;
  • Interested in working on development and troubleshooting of a highly distributed orchestration platform supporting multiple vendors;
  • Strong computer networking knowledge and transport (TCP/UDP/etc.) layers;
  • Knowledge of cloud computing concepts;
  • Experience collaborating effectively across remote teams and time zones, and collaborating with Senior Technical Leaders;
  • Experience with GIT, Jira, Gitlab and code review tools;
  • Experience with container technologies (e.g., Docker, Linux Containers, etc.);
  • Experience with Kubernetes Cluster Administration (design infrastructure that involves one or more Kubernetes clusters, configure, control, and monitor Kubernetes clusters);
  • Experience with Docker;
  • Experience with Helm.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Experience with Kubernetes App Development (design and development of applications that run in Kubernetes clusters);
  • Experience with PostgreSQL as a developer;
  • Experience with RabbitMQ as a developer.

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
We're Hiring: Senior Data Engineer | Remote from Brazil | Fluent English required |


Location : Remote – Brazil only

Contact: PJ - Long Term


Are you passionate about building scalable data platforms and cutting-edge MLOps solutions? Do you want to work with a top-tier US company revolutionizing e-commerce and circular fashion?

We're looking for a Senior Data Engineer with strong MLOps expertise to join our growing data engineering team. This is a full-time , 100% remote opportunity exclusive to candidates located in Brazil . You'll be working with a fast-paced US-based company, leading innovations in sustainable commerce and data-driven operations.


What You’ll Do


  • Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable data infrastructure across real-time and batch workloads.
  • Build and support ML pipelines for model training, deployment, and monitoring.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with data scientists, engineers, and product teams to deliver high-performance data and ML solutions.
  • Develop APIs and services for data ingestion, transformation, and querying.
  • Ensure the reliability of ML systems through strong observability and operational tools.
  • Contribute to architectural decisions and mentor team members.


Tech Stack & Requirements


  • 5+ years as a Data Engineer or MLOps Engineer.
  • Strong experience with Python , Java , or Scala .
  • Hands-on with GCP (preferred), AWS or Azure .
  • Experience with BigQuery , ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch), and container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with Apache Kafka , Spark , or similar tools is a big plus.
  • Experience with ETL , CI/CD , git , and monitoring pipelines .
  • Strong communication skills and fluency in English (written & spoken) is mandatory .
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or related fields.


What We Offer


  • Top-tier hourly rate paid in USD
  • Long-term contract opportunity
  • Fully remote work – collaborate with international teams from the comfort of your home
  • A high-impact role within a data-driven, mission-oriented company

title: Engenheiro de software
description:
O Itaú é a marca mais valiosa do Brasil, a melhor empresa para trabalhar segundo o Great Place to Work e o maior banco da América Latina. Nós impactamos diariamente mais de 98 milhões de clientes em 18 países.


Somos feitos de pessoas e acreditamos que ter um time com pluralidade de origens, culturas, crenças, experiências, raças, deficiências, gêneros, orientações afetivo-sexuais e gerações ampliam as perspectivas e contribuem para um clima de respeito e valorização das diferenças.



Estamos buscando uma pessoa para a posição de ENGENHARIA TI PL - CUSTODIA DE ATIVOS , que queira se desenvolver e aprender, compartilhar, colaborar e inovar, entregando valor para todos os nossos clientes.


Nessa função você vai:



Atuar Engenheiro de TI com experiência em execução de projetos, para se juntar à nossa equipe da Custodia PF.


  • Desenvolver e manter aplicativos utilizando Cobol, DB2 e arquivos VSAM (legado mainframe)
  • Desenvolver e manter aplicativos utilizando Java e Spring Boot.
  • Implementar soluções na nuvem AWS, aproveitando serviços como EC2, S3, Lambda, e outros.
  • Gerenciar bancos de dados SQL (PostgreSQL) e NoSQL (DynamoDB, Redis) p/ garantir desempenho e escala
  • Projetar e implementar arquiteturas de microserviços, garantindo flexibilidade e eficiência.
  • Implementar soluções de observabilidade para monitorar e depurar sistemas em produção.



Solida em desenvolvimento de software utilizando Cobol e DB2.

Experiência solida em desenvolvimento de software utilizando Java e Spring Boot.

Desejável: Certificações relevantes em nuvem e desenvolvimento de software.

Conhecimento pratico em serviços de nuvem AWS. , Proficiência em bancos de dados SQL (pref. PostgreSQL) e NoSQL (DynamoDB, Redis). , Familiaridade com arquiteturas de microserviços e padrões de design associados. , Exp. em implementar soluções de observabilidade, monitoramento, rastreamento e logging.


Desejável vivencia com conteineres Docker e orquestração de contêineres usando Kubernetes , Desejável: Conhecimento em ferramentas de CI/CD (Integração Contínua/Entrega Contínua). , Desejável: Familiaridade com ferramentas de automação de infraestrutura, como Terraform. , Desejável: Experiência em desenvolvimento de aplicações orientadas a eventos.


O Ituber será responsável por projetar, construir e gerenciar soluções modernas e robustas para atender todas as necessidades do produto Consignado.


Esse produto será implementado na plataforma legado (mainframe) mas que em breve será migrado para a nova plataforma na AWS também deve buscar constantemente em aprimorar as habilidades técnicas e conhecimentos em engenharia de TI, mantendo-se atualizado com últimas tendências e tecnologias e sendo responsável por: projetar e implementar arquiteturas escaláveis, desenvolver em plataforma já modernizada, garantir a qualidade e integridade dos dados através de controles e monitoramento.


E ser apaixonado por inovações e soluções que encantem nossos clientes, pares e parceiros. Venha fazer parte desta jornada conosco!!!



Ao se tornar um ituber você tem


  • Vale-Transporte
  • Vale-Refeição (Restaurantes) / Vale-Alimentação (Supermercados)
  • Plano médico (Fundação Saúde Itaú ou Central Nacional Unimed)
  • Plano odontológico (Odontoprev ou Interodonto)
  • Seguro de Vida
  • PLR – Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (Mediante resultados do banco)
  • Previdência privada
  • Descontos exclusivos em nossos produtos financeiros
  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida
  • Auxílio Creche / Babá (para papais e mamães)
  • Incentivo a estudos
  • Wellhub ou TotalPass
  • Acesso aos Clubes de Lazer Itaú (Guarapiranga / Itanhaém e São Sebastião)
  • + Algumas vantagens que você pode conhecer durante o processo

title: Consultor funcional de Oracle AP
description:
A SOMMA IT está em busca de um(a) Consultor(a) Funcional Oracle Cloud AP para integrar nosso time em projetos desafiadores de implementação, rollout e sustentação.


Responsabilidades

  • Atuar em projetos de Oracle Cloud , com foco nos módulos:
  • Accounts Payable (AP): parametrização do módulo, fluxos de aprovação (BPM), fluxo de pagamentos, retenções e integrações bancárias.
  • Fiscal Document Capture (FDC): configuração de regras fiscais, de/para de itens, captura e validação de documentos eletrônicos (NFe, NFSe).
  • Tax (Impostos): modelagem fiscal, retenções na fonte, regras tributárias e parametrização dos motores de cálculo de impostos.
  • Diferencial – Cash Management: parametrização, conciliação bancária, gestão de extratos e previsão de caixa.
  • Conduzir levantamento de requisitos (As Is), preparação de workshops (To Be), configuração do sistema e elaboração de documentos funcionais.
  • Apoiar o cliente em testes, homologações e sustentação (AMS).
  • Atuar como elo entre o time técnico e as áreas de negócio do cliente.

Requisitos

  • Experiência comprovada como consultor(a) funcional em Oracle Cloud (AP, FDC e Tax).
  • Conhecimento sólido de processos financeiros, fiscais e de tesouraria no cenário brasileiro.
  • Vivência com integrações fiscais (motores fiscais, SEFAZ, bancos, VAN bancárias).
  • Capacidade de análise crítica, visão de processo e foco em entrega de valor.
  • Desejável: inglês intermediário, experiência em consultorias, atuação em projetos remotos e presenciais.

Se você busca atuar em projetos estratégicos e ter a oportunidade de crescer em um ambiente colaborativo e inovador, vem para a SOMMA IT !

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Dynamics 365
description:
Especialistas em tecnologias e plataformas para gestão para negócios, somos reconhecidamente, uma das principais provedoras de soluções Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM no Brasil.

Com foco na inovação e comprometidos com a qualidade, nossos projetos já ajudaram muitas empresas a mudarem o futuro das pessoas.

Nossa cultura está baseada em entregar inovação e criatividade com alta performance trazendo para o time, profissionais que possuam espírito inovador, alma empreendedora e obsessão em evoluir.

Então, vamos realizar juntos?

Estamos em busca de talentos que queiram fazer parte de histórias transformacionais.


Suas principais atividades e atribuições estarão ligadas ao desenvolvimento de plug-ins, APIs, integrações e parametrizações na plataforma.


Requisitos:

  • Desenvolvimento C# (Plug-ins do Dataverse e Desenvolvimento de APIs), Javascript e TypeScript;
  • Conhecimento em Dataverse, Power Automate, Power Apps Portals, Model Driven e desenvolvimento de Plug-ins;
  • Conhecimento nos módulos Sales, Customer Service do Dynamics 365, Marketing e Field Service.


Diferenciais:

  • Certificações Microsoft ;
  • Conhecimento na infraestrutura da Power Platform e Azure;
  • Domínio do inglês (leitura e conversação avançada)


Nossos benefícios:

  • Cartão benefício Flash com vale refeição de R$30,00/dia;
  • Parceria com instituições de ensino para graduação e especializações;
  • Assistência médica e odontológica sem coparticipação;
  • Incentivo para educação (idiomas);
  • Aplicativos de saúde e bem-estar;
  • Parceria com o SESC;
  • Modelo de trabalho remoto;
  • Treinamentos e Certificação;
  • Avaliação de desempenho e feedback 1:1


Na Bizapp apoiamos a igualdade de gênero, cor, idade, orientação sexual, crença e deficiência. Por isso, todos os candidatos são considerados igualmente em nossos processos.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
We're Hiring: Senior Data Engineer | Remote from Brazil | Fluent English required |


Location : Remote – Brazil only

Contact: PJ - Long Term


Are you passionate about building scalable data platforms and cutting-edge MLOps solutions? Do you want to work with a top-tier US company revolutionizing e-commerce and circular fashion?

We're looking for a Senior Data Engineer with strong MLOps expertise to join our growing data engineering team. This is a full-time , 100% remote opportunity exclusive to candidates located in Brazil . You'll be working with a fast-paced US-based company, leading innovations in sustainable commerce and data-driven operations.


What You’ll Do


  • Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable data infrastructure across real-time and batch workloads.
  • Build and support ML pipelines for model training, deployment, and monitoring.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with data scientists, engineers, and product teams to deliver high-performance data and ML solutions.
  • Develop APIs and services for data ingestion, transformation, and querying.
  • Ensure the reliability of ML systems through strong observability and operational tools.
  • Contribute to architectural decisions and mentor team members.


Tech Stack & Requirements


  • 5+ years as a Data Engineer or MLOps Engineer.
  • Strong experience with Python , Java , or Scala .
  • Hands-on with GCP (preferred), AWS or Azure .
  • Experience with BigQuery , ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch), and container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with Apache Kafka , Spark , or similar tools is a big plus.
  • Experience with ETL , CI/CD , git , and monitoring pipelines .
  • Strong communication skills and fluency in English (written & spoken) is mandatory .
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or related fields.


What We Offer


  • Top-tier hourly rate paid in USD
  • Long-term contract opportunity
  • Fully remote work – collaborate with international teams from the comfort of your home
  • A high-impact role within a data-driven, mission-oriented company

Requisitos

  • Experiência comprovada como consultor(a) funcional em Oracle Cloud (AP, FDC e Tax).
  • Conhecimento sólido de processos financeiros, fiscais e de tesouraria no cenário brasileiro.
  • Vivência com integrações fiscais (motores fiscais, SEFAZ, bancos, VAN bancárias).
  • Capacidade de análise crítica, visão de processo e foco em entrega de valor.
