We are seeking an experienced Senior Splunk Engineer to take over and operate the on-premise Splunk SIEM platform. As part of the transition from Infosys, you will be responsible for stabilizing and continuously improving an existing enterprise-scale SIEM environment.


You will own all Splunk operations across Plan & Build, 24/7 Operations, Release & Patch Management, CIM-based Log Onboarding, Parser development, Hardening, Configuration Management, and Incident/Problem/Change processes.


Responsibilities

1. Plan & Build

  • Perform CIM-compliant log onboarding, parser creation, documentation.
  • Conduct onboarding due diligence and demand analysis.
  • Create Firewall/VPN/Routing change requests and validate changes.
  • Manage ingestion pipelines via Cribl, Syslog-ng (TLS), Splunk UF/HF, SCP.
  • Deploy and scale Splunk components using Terraform and Ansible.
  • Build trend and capacity analyses.


2. Operations (24/7 enterprise-grade operations)

  • Ensure full Splunk platform operation, monitoring, performance, EPS/log flow.
  • Handle Incidents, Service Requests, Changes, and Problems under MBG ITSM.
  • Lead Major Incident Management (P1/P2) with 24/7 on-call rotation.
  • Build and operate Health Check dashboards and QA reports.


3. Configuration & Release Management

  • Implement approved changes across Splunk components.
  • Perform daily configuration backups (KV stores, Apps, Configs).
  • Maintain automation libraries (Terraform, Ansible, scripts).
  • Manage Splunk patching and releases (maintain N-1 level).
  • Support up to 12 minor + 1 major release per year.


4. Security, Hardening & Compliance

  • System hardening and vulnerability remediation.
  • Operate via secure access methods (Jump hosts, SuSSHi, 2FA).
  • Conduct vulnerability scans and support SOC threat analysis.
  • Automate SOP-based operational workflows.


5. Transition

  • Take over existing MBG Splunk operations.
  • Validate and enhance current configurations, parsers, and deployments.
  • Ensure stability during transition and hypercare.


Requirements

Technical Skills

  • 5–10 years Splunk/SIEM experience in large enterprises.
  • Expertise in Splunk Architecture, CIM onboarding, parser development, Syslog-ng, certificates.
  • Strong scripting: Terraform, Ansible, Bash/Python.
  • Experience stabilizing existing SIEM environments.



Certifications (required)

Minimum two of:

  • Splunk Core Certified User
  • Splunk Core Certified Power User
  • Splunk Enterprise Admin
  • Splunk Enterprise Architect
  • Optional: Splunk ES


Soft Skills

  • Strong communication in enterprise environments.
  • Clear documentation skills.
  • Proactive, quality-driven work style.
  • Fluent English (German beneficial).

title: Desenvolvedor(a) SAP Full Stack - PL/SR
description:
We Transform. SAP® Solutions into Value


A transformação digital ajuda as empresas a atingirem seu potencial máximo - se as tecnologias funcionarem para as pessoas que as utilizam! A NTT DATA Business Solutions está há 30 anos no mercado mundial. Somos uma empresa apaixonada por transformação. E queremos transformar o mundo e as pessoas através das soluções que criamos juntos com nossos parceiros. Aqui projetamos, implementamos, gerenciamos e potencializamos continuamente as soluções SAP para fazê-las funcionar para as empresas – e para as pessoas.


Fazemos parte do grupo NTT DATA – um dos 10 maiores provedores de tecnologia do mundo – segundo o Gartner, e juntos somos mais de 130.000 colaboradores espalhados em 53 países. Nossa meta é impactar positivamente o mundo ajudando a criar uma sociedade mais conectada, diversa e criativa.


Buscamos um(a) profissional SAP FullStack (Pleno ou Sênior) para atuar em ambientes SAP S/4HANA, com foco em desenvolvimento moderno utilizando o modelo RAP e aplicações Fiori. A posição envolve atuação ponta a ponta, desde a camada de dados e serviços até a interface, colaborando com arquitetos e consultores funcionais em times ágeis ou híbridos.


Principais Responsabilidades


  • Desenvolver soluções SAP FullStack no ambiente S/4HANA.
  • Implementar serviços utilizando o modelo RAP (RESTful ABAP Programming Model).
  • Criar e manter CDS Views (projection, exposure e behavior) e Behavior Definitions.
  • Desenvolver Service Definitions e Service Bindings com exposição via OData V4.
  • Construir aplicações com Fiori Elements.
  • Atuar com ABAP OO seguindo boas práticas de Clean Code e qualidade de código.
  • Realizar revisões de código e aplicar padrões de qualidade e sustentabilidade técnica.
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com arquitetos, consultores funcionais e times ágeis.


Requisitos:


  • Experiência prática com SAP S/4HANA.
  • Domínio do modelo RAP.
  • Conhecimento sólido em ABAP Orientado a Objetos.
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de atuação em times ágeis ou híbridos.
  • Mentalidade orientada a Clean Code, qualidade e manutenção evolutiva.


Diferenciais (Desejável):


  • Participação em pelo menos uma implementação greenfield de SAP S/4HANA.
  • Experiência com ATC, SCI ou outras ferramentas de qualidade de código.
  • Certificações SAP.
  • Inglês intermediário/ avançado.


Regime de contratação: CLT

100% Remoto no Brasil

Viagens pontoais (2-3 vezes ao ano)


Liberte todo o seu potencial e engenhosidade – molde o seu próprio futuro. Somos mais do que apenas um local de trabalho; somos uma incubadora de talentos. Com diversos caminhos e oportunidades de aprendizado e carreira de longo prazo, oferecemos inúmeras maneiras de realizar seus sonhos.


*Todas as vagas da NTT DATA são destinadas também para pessoas com deficiência.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
About the Product

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Job Purpose

A Designer on the Content & Engagement team is a skilled strategic thinker who is responsible for crafting highly branded and conversion-optimized creative across the divisions of Carnegie.


Duties and Responsibilities

  • Team Leadership
  • Work with team leaders and colleagues across Carnegie to optimize the team’s efficiency and effectiveness by identifying possible improvements to workflow, and scheduling
  • Champion project collaboration, working to motivate team members and ensure smooth and proactive interactions and processes
  • Design Development
  • Formulate clear and thoughtful content strategies to meet organizational objectives
  • Move design strategies to action, creating high-quality, highly branded, cohesive design constructs across communication channels (print, web, social, video, etc.) that tell a compelling story
  • Foster a collaborative, solutions-oriented culture that champions client success
  • Cross-Divisional Strategy
  • Facilitate knowledge sharing as necessary to ensure that campaign strategy is understood.
  • Be well-versed in translating performance metrics into actionable takeaways
  • Represent content decisions on client discovery and presentation calls with clarity, confidence, and professionalism
  • Optimization & Innovation
  • Analyze conversion metrics to understand what resonates with audiences and drive content iteration
  • Contribute to innovations and improvements in client-facing products and services as well as internal processes
  • Foster a culture of innovation and creative problem-solving by staying up-to-date on industry trends, emerging technologies, and marketing best practices


Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Excellent organizational and highly developed collaboration, problem-solving, and project management skills to thrive in a fast-paced work environment with a large client portfolio
  • Ability to think outside the box to develop bold and innovative storytelling strategies while developing differentiated, compelling, and original creative work
  • Public speaking skills for high levels of client interaction and ability to listen carefully and navigate organizational politics
  • Consistent ability to critically evaluate the quality of creative work and guide revisions while coaching the best creative work from colleagues and direct reports
  • Thorough knowledge of creative tools, including Adobe, Microsoft Office Suite, and Google Office
  • Competency in prompt engineering and utilizing Artificial Intelligence tools, such as ChatGPT and Generative AI, throughout the creative process
  • Effective communication and time management skills for a remote work environment as well as the ability to use/learn multiple technology platforms and switch between them on a regular basis
  • Must be able to work at a computer for prolonged periods
  • Thorough knowledge of print and digital communication development to effectively work across media
  • Due to the remote environment, effective communication and time management skills are required, as well as the ability to use/learn multiple technology platforms and switch between them on a regular basis
  • Physical requirement: Must be able to work at a computer for prolonged periods


Credentials and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Graphic Design, Fine Arts, or related field
  • 3 or more years of professional graphic design experience
  • Robust portfolio of design samples and case studies that demonstrate measurable success


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Técnico(a) de Suporte para atuar em um ambiente dinâmico, multicultural e com foco em excelência no atendimento ao usuário. A posição terá papel fundamental no suporte técnico, gestão de incidentes e solicitações, além de apoiar na documentação e monitoramento de processos e projetos.


Informações da vaga

  • Modelo de trabalho: 100% Home Office;
  • Horário: 04h00 às 12h00.


Responsabilidades

  • Atuar como ponto focal para que usuários relatem problemas e solicitações;
  • Gerenciar incidentes e solicitações de serviço, garantindo acompanhamento e resolução adequada;
  • Fornecer resolução de chamados no primeiro contato, com base em instruções e procedimentos de trabalho;
  • Monitorar atividades e apoiar na redação de documentações de projetos, como descrição de tarefas, casos de uso e instruções operacionais;
  • Utilizar ferramentas de monitoramento e gestão para registro, acompanhamento e controle dos chamados.


Requisitos

  • Conhecimento em Pacote Office;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de monitoramento e gestão de chamados, como ServiceNow, Jira, Service Manager ou CISM.


Idiomas

  • Inglês e Alemão em nível avançado.


O que oferecemos

  • Ambiente colaborativo e multicultural;
  • Oportunidade de desenvolvimento profissional em uma das líderes globais em tecnologia.

title: General Manager Operations
description:
About the Company

Hello! Welcome to Plaza Premium Group, we're people passionate about \"Making Travel Better\". We are a global company with team members from all walks of life, together we are #PPGFamily, together we are building a legacy. You don't need to be from this industry, you do need to be passionate.



Our promise to you:


-We will respect and value your background and perspectives

-We will work together with integrity

-We will share our incredible pride for job, company, and industry


What we ask of you:


-Bring passion to all that you do

-Listen, move fast and think innovatively

-Speak up, have ideas, and share them

-Believe in customer service, and treating every person with kindness


As industry leaders in innovating global airport hospitality, you will work with colleagues from all parts of the world for a truly global experience. You will help and craft services and facilities in over 200 locations in more than 60 international airports across the world.


Who we are:


We were established in HK in 1998 by someone who understood the value of an airport lounge and felt that the experience shouldn't just be limited to a closed-circuit group of travellers. Through the years we have worked incredibly hard to create an experience that is both accessible and quality. Almost 26 years later we now span four core business segments: airport lounges, airport terminal hotels, airport meet & greet services, and a range of airport dining concepts. In addition to our own brands, PPG provides airport hospitality solutions to leading airlines, alliances, and corporates around the world. Here are a few names you might recognize: Cathay Pacific Airways, Singapore Airlines, Lufthansa, etc.


With the future of travel always insight, we created Smart Traveller, a mobile-app rewards program underpinned by in-house technology. We are fast-moving and always evolving to drive our purpose of making travel better.


Join our family today.

Together, we'll make travel better.


About the job:


The General Manager of Operations is accountable for overseeing the entire operational ecosystem for Plaza Premium within the Rio de Janeiro airport system. This leadership role ensures that all guest touchpoints deliver the highest standards of quality, efficiency, and hospitality, providing an exceptional experience for every traveller. The General Manager of Operations is responsible for operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and guest satisfaction across all services.


Operational Management:

title: SDR Closer (SaaS) Food Service
description:
A Jupiter - Segurança Cibernética e Tecnologia é uma empresa brasileira que fornece soluções inovadoras para segurança cibernética e automação de processos. Com mais de 10 anos de experiência, nosso time altamente qualificado desenvolve e implementa soluções personalizadas alinhadas às melhores práticas de mercado para atender às necessidades específicas de diversos setores. Nossos serviços abrangem desde consultoria em arquitetura de segurança até automação de processos, segurança cibernética ofensiva e defensiva, e gestão de identidades e acessos. Priorizamos a eficiência e a inovação, fornecendo suporte especializado e flexível para garantir a proteção e o crescimento sustentável dos negócios de nossos clientes.


Buscamos um(a) Closer B2B (SaaS), com perfil hands-on, autonomia e foco em resultado. Essa pessoa será responsável por conduzir o ciclo completo de vendas de uma solução SaaS, atuando de forma consultiva desde o diagnóstico até o fechamento, com responsabilidade sobre forecast, ritmo comercial e conversão.

É uma posição estratégica para quem já viveu rotinas de crescimento, estruturação e evolução de processo comercial - e gosta de melhorar o jogo enquanto vende.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Conduzir reuniões consultivas e diagnósticos com decisores (discovery e qualificação).
  • Apresentar a solução SaaS traduzindo funcionalidades em valor de negócio (impacto, risco, eficiência, ROI).
  • Construir, ajustar e negociar propostas comerciais personalizadas (escopo, planos, condições e prazos).
  • Gerenciar pipeline e follow-ups com disciplina em CRM (organização, próximos passos, previsibilidade e cadência).
  • Fechar contratos e garantir a transição estruturada para jurídico e pós-vendas/onboarding.
  • Contribuir com melhorias contínuas de processo, discurso, playbook e funil de vendas com base em dados.


Requisitos

  • Experiência comprovada em vendas consultivas B2B, preferencialmente com SaaS (ciclo de venda, negociação e fechamento).
  • Perfil hands-on, alta autonomia e responsabilidade por metas.
  • Capacidade de conduzir diagnósticos, lidar com objeções e negociar contratos de média complexidade.
  • Organização e disciplina na gestão de pipeline, forecast e cadência comercial.
  • Experiência prática com CRM (ex.: Pipedrive, Salesforce, RD Station CRM, Dynamics, Zoho ou similares).
  • Adaptabilidade para atuar em ambiente dinâmico e em evolução de processos.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência em reestruturação/otimização de processos comerciais e construção de playbooks.
  • Vivência com SaaS, inteligência de mídia, comunicação, reputação, dados, marketing ou martech.
  • Escrita persuasiva e abordagem consultiva orientada a dados.
  • Conhecimento de SCRUM/Agile (ex.: rotina com squads, cerimônias, priorização e entregas iterativas).
  • Formação em Publicidade, Marketing, Comunicação, Administração, Gestão Comercial, Vendas ou áreas correlatas.
  • Diferencial: experiência com sistemas (SaaS/ERP/PDV/CRM/automação) e/ou vendas para empresas de food service (bares, restaurantes, redes, dark kitchens, franquias, distribuidoras e operações multiunidade), entendendo rotinas operacionais, dores de atendimento, controle, compliance e indicadores do setor.


Modalidade

PJ | Remoto

title: Senior Splunk Engineer
description:
Overview

We are seeking an experienced Senior Splunk Engineer to take over and operate the on-premise Splunk SIEM platform. As part of the transition from Infosys, you will be responsible for stabilizing and continuously improving an existing enterprise-scale SIEM environment.


You will own all Splunk operations across Plan & Build, 24/7 Operations, Release & Patch Management, CIM-based Log Onboarding, Parser development, Hardening, Configuration Management, and Incident/Problem/Change processes.


Responsibilities

1. Plan & Build

  • Perform CIM-compliant log onboarding, parser creation, documentation.
  • Conduct onboarding due diligence and demand analysis.
  • Create Firewall/VPN/Routing change requests and validate changes.
  • Manage ingestion pipelines via Cribl, Syslog-ng (TLS), Splunk UF/HF, SCP.
  • Deploy and scale Splunk components using Terraform and Ansible.
  • Build trend and capacity analyses.


2. Operations (24/7 enterprise-grade operations)

  • Ensure full Splunk platform operation, monitoring, performance, EPS/log flow.
  • Handle Incidents, Service Requests, Changes, and Problems under MBG ITSM.
  • Lead Major Incident Management (P1/P2) with 24/7 on-call rotation.
  • Build and operate Health Check dashboards and QA reports.


3. Configuration & Release Management

  • Implement approved changes across Splunk components.
  • Perform daily configuration backups (KV stores, Apps, Configs).
  • Maintain automation libraries (Terraform, Ansible, scripts).
  • Manage Splunk patching and releases (maintain N-1 level).
  • Support up to 12 minor + 1 major release per year.


4. Security, Hardening & Compliance

  • System hardening and vulnerability remediation.
  • Operate via secure access methods (Jump hosts, SuSSHi, 2FA).
  • Conduct vulnerability scans and support SOC threat analysis.
  • Automate SOP-based operational workflows.


5. Transition

  • Take over existing MBG Splunk operations.
  • Validate and enhance current configurations, parsers, and deployments.
  • Ensure stability during transition and hypercare.


Requirements

Technical Skills

  • 5–10 years Splunk/SIEM experience in large enterprises.
  • Expertise in Splunk Architecture, CIM onboarding, parser development, Syslog-ng, certificates.
  • Strong scripting: Terraform, Ansible, Bash/Python.
  • Experience stabilizing existing SIEM environments.



Certifications (required)

Minimum two of:

  • Splunk Core Certified User
  • Splunk Core Certified Power User
  • Splunk Enterprise Admin
  • Splunk Enterprise Architect
  • Optional: Splunk ES


Soft Skills

  • Strong communication in enterprise environments.
  • Clear documentation skills.
  • Proactive, quality-driven work style.
  • Fluent English (German beneficial).

title: Manufacturing Quality and Aftersales Specialist
description:
About Vammo

Vammo is building an accessible, resilient, and scalable clean energy network for emerging megacities, starting in Latin America. By combining electric motorcycle subscriptions with a rapidly expanding battery swap infrastructure, we make clean transportation affordable and reliable for the millions who keep cities moving.


Founded in 2022 and headquartered in São Paulo, Vammo has raised $100M from top-tier investors across the globe. Our founders and team represent an incredibly diverse and international group that is built of former executives coming from Tesla, Uber, Rappi, iFood, Loggi, Niu, Jump and others. We are all deeply motivated by the mission to decarbonize Latin America while simultaneously reducing costs for one of the region’s most vulnerable populations.


The next wave of mobility innovation will come not from San Francisco, but from São Paulo. Our operations will soon expand from Sao Paulo to cities across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia, proving that real climate impact and transformative business models can be built first where the need is greatest.

About the Role:

As a Manufacturing Quality and Aftersales Specialist, you will play a vital role in our commitment to implementing best practices in quality control. This position is dedicated to ensuring the highest quality standards in our products through collaboration with suppliers, monitoring quality processes, and enhancing our aftersales services. Your contributions will not only enhance our products and services but also strengthen positive relationships with our customers.Job Description:

  • Collaborate with suppliers to establish clear quality expectations and standards for components and materials.
  • Evaluate suppliers reports to ensure compliance with quality standards and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Monitor the quality processes for incoming materials, documenting and analyzing relevant data and processes.
  • Manage warranty processes with suppliers, including the preparation and submission of technical reports, claims, and supporting documentation.
  • Create detailed reports on product quality metrics and supplier performance, identifying trends and opportunities for enhancement.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams to communicate findings and recommend actions that improve product quality and customer satisfaction.


Hard Skills:

  • Experience in quality assurance, supplier management, or a related field within manufacturing or the automotive industry.
  • Proficiency in quality management systems and reporting tools that facilitate effective data analysis.
  • Strong analytical skills to assess product performance and identify recurring quality issues.
  • Advanced English proficiency for effective drafting and communication.


Soft Skills:

  • Highly Disciplined:  Demonstrates a strong commitment to accuracy, organization, and consistency in all tasks.
  • Process-Oriented Thinking:  Employs systematic thinking to analyze workflows and enhance problem-solving capabilities, ensuring efficiency in processes.
  • Attention to Detail:  Conducts thorough evaluations of supplier quality and product performance, focusing on delivering high-quality outcomes.
  • Effective Communication Skills:  Communicates clearly and concisely with stakeholders, fostering collaboration and mutual understanding across teams.

title: Especialista em Integração / Líder Técnico de Integração
description:
Descrição da Vaga

Estamos em busca de Especialistas em Integração / Líderes Técnicos de Integração para atuar no desenho, implementação e liderança técnica de soluções de integração robustas, escaláveis e de alta performance.   • Desenhar e implementar arquiteturas baseadas em eventos, mensageria e APIs.
  • Definir padrões, boas práticas e guidelines de integração.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) SAP Full Stack - PL/SR
description:
We Transform. SAP® Solutions into Value


A transformação digital ajuda as empresas a atingirem seu potencial máximo - se as tecnologias funcionarem para as pessoas que as utilizam! A NTT DATA Business Solutions está há 30 anos no mercado mundial. Somos uma empresa apaixonada por transformação. E queremos transformar o mundo e as pessoas através das soluções que criamos juntos com nossos parceiros. Aqui projetamos, implementamos, gerenciamos e potencializamos continuamente as soluções SAP para fazê-las funcionar para as empresas – e para as pessoas.


Fazemos parte do grupo NTT DATA – um dos 10 maiores provedores de tecnologia do mundo – segundo o Gartner, e juntos somos mais de 130.000 colaboradores espalhados em 53 países. Nossa meta é impactar positivamente o mundo ajudando a criar uma sociedade mais conectada, diversa e criativa.


Buscamos um(a) profissional SAP FullStack (Pleno ou Sênior) para atuar em ambientes SAP S/4HANA, com foco em desenvolvimento moderno utilizando o modelo RAP e aplicações Fiori. A posição envolve atuação ponta a ponta, desde a camada de dados e serviços até a interface, colaborando com arquitetos e consultores funcionais em times ágeis ou híbridos.


Principais Responsabilidades


  • Desenvolver soluções SAP FullStack no ambiente S/4HANA.
  • Implementar serviços utilizando o modelo RAP (RESTful ABAP Programming Model).
  • Criar e manter CDS Views (projection, exposure e behavior) e Behavior Definitions.
  • Desenvolver Service Definitions e Service Bindings com exposição via OData V4.
  • Construir aplicações com Fiori Elements.
  • Atuar com ABAP OO seguindo boas práticas de Clean Code e qualidade de código.
  • Realizar revisões de código e aplicar padrões de qualidade e sustentabilidade técnica.
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com arquitetos, consultores funcionais e times ágeis.


Requisitos:


  • Experiência prática com SAP S/4HANA.
  • Domínio do modelo RAP.
  • Conhecimento sólido em ABAP Orientado a Objetos.
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de atuação em times ágeis ou híbridos.
  • Mentalidade orientada a Clean Code, qualidade e manutenção evolutiva.


Diferenciais (Desejável):


  • Participação em pelo menos uma implementação greenfield de SAP S/4HANA.
  • Experiência com ATC, SCI ou outras ferramentas de qualidade de código.
  • Certificações SAP.
  • Inglês intermediário/ avançado.


Regime de contratação: CLT

100% Remoto no Brasil

Viagens pontoais (2-3 vezes ao ano)


Liberte todo o seu potencial e engenhosidade – molde o seu próprio futuro. Somos mais do que apenas um local de trabalho; somos uma incubadora de talentos. Com diversos caminhos e oportunidades de aprendizado e carreira de longo prazo, oferecemos inúmeras maneiras de realizar seus sonhos.


*Todas as vagas da NTT DATA são destinadas também para pessoas com deficiência.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
About the Product

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Job Purpose

A Designer on the Content & Engagement team is a skilled strategic thinker who is responsible for crafting highly branded and conversion-optimized creative across the divisions of Carnegie.


Duties and Responsibilities

  • Team Leadership
  • Work with team leaders and colleagues across Carnegie to optimize the team’s efficiency and effectiveness by identifying possible improvements to workflow, and scheduling
  • Champion project collaboration, working to motivate team members and ensure smooth and proactive interactions and processes
  • Design Development
  • Formulate clear and thoughtful content strategies to meet organizational objectives
  • Move design strategies to action, creating high-quality, highly branded, cohesive design constructs across communication channels (print, web, social, video, etc.) that tell a compelling story
  • Foster a collaborative, solutions-oriented culture that champions client success
  • Cross-Divisional Strategy
  • Facilitate knowledge sharing as necessary to ensure that campaign strategy is understood.
  • Be well-versed in translating performance metrics into actionable takeaways
  • Represent content decisions on client discovery and presentation calls with clarity, confidence, and professionalism
  • Optimization & Innovation
  • Analyze conversion metrics to understand what resonates with audiences and drive content iteration
  • Contribute to innovations and improvements in client-facing products and services as well as internal processes
  • Foster a culture of innovation and creative problem-solving by staying up-to-date on industry trends, emerging technologies, and marketing best practices


Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Excellent organizational and highly developed collaboration, problem-solving, and project management skills to thrive in a fast-paced work environment with a large client portfolio
  • Ability to think outside the box to develop bold and innovative storytelling strategies while developing differentiated, compelling, and original creative work
  • Public speaking skills for high levels of client interaction and ability to listen carefully and navigate organizational politics
  • Consistent ability to critically evaluate the quality of creative work and guide revisions while coaching the best creative work from colleagues and direct reports
  • Thorough knowledge of creative tools, including Adobe, Microsoft Office Suite, and Google Office
  • Competency in prompt engineering and utilizing Artificial Intelligence tools, such as ChatGPT and Generative AI, throughout the creative process
  • Effective communication and time management skills for a remote work environment as well as the ability to use/learn multiple technology platforms and switch between them on a regular basis
  • Must be able to work at a computer for prolonged periods
  • Thorough knowledge of print and digital communication development to effectively work across media
  • Due to the remote environment, effective communication and time management skills are required, as well as the ability to use/learn multiple technology platforms and switch between them on a regular basis
  • Physical requirement: Must be able to work at a computer for prolonged periods


Credentials and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Graphic Design, Fine Arts, or related field
  • 3 or more years of professional graphic design experience
  • Robust portfolio of design samples and case studies that demonstrate measurable success


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.

title: Senior Splunk Engineer
description:
Overview

We are seeking an experienced Senior Splunk Engineer to take over and operate the on-premise Splunk SIEM platform. As part of the transition from Infosys, you will be responsible for stabilizing and continuously improving an existing enterprise-scale SIEM environment.


You will own all Splunk operations across Plan & Build, 24/7 Operations, Release & Patch Management, CIM-based Log Onboarding, Parser development, Hardening, Configuration Management, and Incident/Problem/Change processes.


Responsibilities

1. Plan & Build

  • Perform CIM-compliant log onboarding, parser creation, documentation.
  • Conduct onboarding due diligence and demand analysis.
  • Create Firewall/VPN/Routing change requests and validate changes.
  • Manage ingestion pipelines via Cribl, Syslog-ng (TLS), Splunk UF/HF, SCP.
  • Deploy and scale Splunk components using Terraform and Ansible.
  • Build trend and capacity analyses.


2. Operations (24/7 enterprise-grade operations)

  • Ensure full Splunk platform operation, monitoring, performance, EPS/log flow.
  • Handle Incidents, Service Requests, Changes, and Problems under MBG ITSM.
  • Lead Major Incident Management (P1/P2) with 24/7 on-call rotation.
  • Build and operate Health Check dashboards and QA reports.


3. Configuration & Release Management

  • Implement approved changes across Splunk components.
  • Perform daily configuration backups (KV stores, Apps, Configs).
  • Maintain automation libraries (Terraform, Ansible, scripts).
  • Manage Splunk patching and releases (maintain N-1 level).
  • Support up to 12 minor + 1 major release per year.


4. Security, Hardening & Compliance

  • System hardening and vulnerability remediation.
  • Operate via secure access methods (Jump hosts, SuSSHi, 2FA).
  • Conduct vulnerability scans and support SOC threat analysis.
  • Automate SOP-based operational workflows.


5. Transition

  • Take over existing MBG Splunk operations.
  • Validate and enhance current configurations, parsers, and deployments.
  • Ensure stability during transition and hypercare.


Requirements

Technical Skills

  • 5–10 years Splunk/SIEM experience in large enterprises.
  • Expertise in Splunk Architecture, CIM onboarding, parser development, Syslog-ng, certificates.
  • Strong scripting: Terraform, Ansible, Bash/Python.
  • Experience stabilizing existing SIEM environments.



Certifications (required)

Minimum two of:

  • Splunk Core Certified User
  • Splunk Core Certified Power User
  • Splunk Enterprise Admin
  • Splunk Enterprise Architect
  • Optional: Splunk ES


Soft Skills

  • Strong communication in enterprise environments.
  • Clear documentation skills.
  • Proactive, quality-driven work style.
  • Fluent English (German beneficial).

title: Desenvolvedor(a) SAP Full Stack - PL/SR
description:
We Transform. SAP® Solutions into Value


A transformação digital ajuda as empresas a atingirem seu potencial máximo - se as tecnologias funcionarem para as pessoas que as utilizam! A NTT DATA Business Solutions está há 30 anos no mercado mundial. Somos uma empresa apaixonada por transformação. E queremos transformar o mundo e as pessoas através das soluções que criamos juntos com nossos parceiros. Aqui projetamos, implementamos, gerenciamos e potencializamos continuamente as soluções SAP para fazê-las funcionar para as empresas – e para as pessoas.


Fazemos parte do grupo NTT DATA – um dos 10 maiores provedores de tecnologia do mundo – segundo o Gartner, e juntos somos mais de 130.000 colaboradores espalhados em 53 países. Nossa meta é impactar positivamente o mundo ajudando a criar uma sociedade mais conectada, diversa e criativa.


Buscamos um(a) profissional SAP FullStack (Pleno ou Sênior) para atuar em ambientes SAP S/4HANA, com foco em desenvolvimento moderno utilizando o modelo RAP e aplicações Fiori. A posição envolve atuação ponta a ponta, desde a camada de dados e serviços até a interface, colaborando com arquitetos e consultores funcionais em times ágeis ou híbridos.


Principais Responsabilidades


  • Desenvolver soluções SAP FullStack no ambiente S/4HANA.
  • Implementar serviços utilizando o modelo RAP (RESTful ABAP Programming Model).
  • Criar e manter CDS Views (projection, exposure e behavior) e Behavior Definitions.
  • Desenvolver Service Definitions e Service Bindings com exposição via OData V4.
  • Construir aplicações com Fiori Elements.
  • Atuar com ABAP OO seguindo boas práticas de Clean Code e qualidade de código.
  • Realizar revisões de código e aplicar padrões de qualidade e sustentabilidade técnica.
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com arquitetos, consultores funcionais e times ágeis.


Requisitos:


  • Experiência prática com SAP S/4HANA.
  • Domínio do modelo RAP.
  • Conhecimento sólido em ABAP Orientado a Objetos.
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de atuação em times ágeis ou híbridos.
  • Mentalidade orientada a Clean Code, qualidade e manutenção evolutiva.


Diferenciais (Desejável):


  • Participação em pelo menos uma implementação greenfield de SAP S/4HANA.
  • Experiência com ATC, SCI ou outras ferramentas de qualidade de código.
  • Certificações SAP.
  • Inglês intermediário/ avançado.


Regime de contratação: CLT

100% Remoto no Brasil

Viagens pontoais (2-3 vezes ao ano)


Liberte todo o seu potencial e engenhosidade – molde o seu próprio futuro. Somos mais do que apenas um local de trabalho; somos uma incubadora de talentos. Com diversos caminhos e oportunidades de aprendizado e carreira de longo prazo, oferecemos inúmeras maneiras de realizar seus sonhos.


*Todas as vagas da NTT DATA são destinadas também para pessoas com deficiência.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
About the Product

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Job Purpose

A Designer on the Content & Engagement team is a skilled strategic thinker who is responsible for crafting highly branded and conversion-optimized creative across the divisions of Carnegie.


Duties and Responsibilities

  • Team Leadership
  • Work with team leaders and colleagues across Carnegie to optimize the team’s efficiency and effectiveness by identifying possible improvements to workflow, and scheduling
  • Champion project collaboration, working to motivate team members and ensure smooth and proactive interactions and processes
  • Design Development
  • Formulate clear and thoughtful content strategies to meet organizational objectives
  • Move design strategies to action, creating high-quality, highly branded, cohesive design constructs across communication channels (print, web, social, video, etc.) that tell a compelling story
  • Foster a collaborative, solutions-oriented culture that champions client success
  • Cross-Divisional Strategy
  • Facilitate knowledge sharing as necessary to ensure that campaign strategy is understood.
  • Be well-versed in translating performance metrics into actionable takeaways
  • Represent content decisions on client discovery and presentation calls with clarity, confidence, and professionalism
  • Optimization & Innovation
  • Analyze conversion metrics to understand what resonates with audiences and drive content iteration
  • Contribute to innovations and improvements in client-facing products and services as well as internal processes
  • Foster a culture of innovation and creative problem-solving by staying up-to-date on industry trends, emerging technologies, and marketing best practices


Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Excellent organizational and highly developed collaboration, problem-solving, and project management skills to thrive in a fast-paced work environment with a large client portfolio
  • Ability to think outside the box to develop bold and innovative storytelling strategies while developing differentiated, compelling, and original creative work
  • Public speaking skills for high levels of client interaction and ability to listen carefully and navigate organizational politics
  • Consistent ability to critically evaluate the quality of creative work and guide revisions while coaching the best creative work from colleagues and direct reports
  • Thorough knowledge of creative tools, including Adobe, Microsoft Office Suite, and Google Office
  • Competency in prompt engineering and utilizing Artificial Intelligence tools, such as ChatGPT and Generative AI, throughout the creative process
  • Effective communication and time management skills for a remote work environment as well as the ability to use/learn multiple technology platforms and switch between them on a regular basis
  • Must be able to work at a computer for prolonged periods
  • Thorough knowledge of print and digital communication development to effectively work across media
  • Due to the remote environment, effective communication and time management skills are required, as well as the ability to use/learn multiple technology platforms and switch between them on a regular basis
  • Physical requirement: Must be able to work at a computer for prolonged periods


Credentials and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Graphic Design, Fine Arts, or related field
  • 3 or more years of professional graphic design experience
  • Robust portfolio of design samples and case studies that demonstrate measurable success


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.

title: Analista de Suporte e Monitoramento
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Técnico(a) de Suporte para atuar em um ambiente dinâmico, multicultural e com foco em excelência no atendimento ao usuário. A posição terá papel fundamental no suporte técnico, gestão de incidentes e solicitações, além de apoiar na documentação e monitoramento de processos e projetos.


Informações da vaga

  • Modelo de trabalho: 100% Home Office;
  • Horário: 04h00 às 12h00.


Responsabilidades

  • Atuar como ponto focal para que usuários relatem problemas e solicitações;
  • Gerenciar incidentes e solicitações de serviço, garantindo acompanhamento e resolução adequada;
  • Fornecer resolução de chamados no primeiro contato, com base em instruções e procedimentos de trabalho;
  • Monitorar atividades e apoiar na redação de documentações de projetos, como descrição de tarefas, casos de uso e instruções operacionais;
  • Utilizar ferramentas de monitoramento e gestão para registro, acompanhamento e controle dos chamados.


Requisitos

  • Conhecimento em Pacote Office;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de monitoramento e gestão de chamados, como ServiceNow, Jira, Service Manager ou CISM.


Idiomas

  • Inglês e Alemão em nível avançado.


O que oferecemos

  • Ambiente colaborativo e multicultural;
  • Oportunidade de desenvolvimento profissional em uma das líderes globais em tecnologia.

title: SDR Closer (SaaS) Food Service
description:
A Jupiter - Segurança Cibernética e Tecnologia é uma empresa brasileira que fornece soluções inovadoras para segurança cibernética e automação de processos. Com mais de 10 anos de experiência, nosso time altamente qualificado desenvolve e implementa soluções personalizadas alinhadas às melhores práticas de mercado para atender às necessidades específicas de diversos setores. Nossos serviços abrangem desde consultoria em arquitetura de segurança até automação de processos, segurança cibernética ofensiva e defensiva, e gestão de identidades e acessos. Priorizamos a eficiência e a inovação, fornecendo suporte especializado e flexível para garantir a proteção e o crescimento sustentável dos negócios de nossos clientes.


Buscamos um(a) Closer B2B (SaaS), com perfil hands-on, autonomia e foco em resultado. Essa pessoa será responsável por conduzir o ciclo completo de vendas de uma solução SaaS, atuando de forma consultiva desde o diagnóstico até o fechamento, com responsabilidade sobre forecast, ritmo comercial e conversão.

É uma posição estratégica para quem já viveu rotinas de crescimento, estruturação e evolução de processo comercial - e gosta de melhorar o jogo enquanto vende.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Conduzir reuniões consultivas e diagnósticos com decisores (discovery e qualificação).
  • Apresentar a solução SaaS traduzindo funcionalidades em valor de negócio (impacto, risco, eficiência, ROI).
  • Construir, ajustar e negociar propostas comerciais personalizadas (escopo, planos, condições e prazos).
  • Gerenciar pipeline e follow-ups com disciplina em CRM (organização, próximos passos, previsibilidade e cadência).
  • Fechar contratos e garantir a transição estruturada para jurídico e pós-vendas/onboarding.
  • Contribuir com melhorias contínuas de processo, discurso, playbook e funil de vendas com base em dados.


Requisitos

  • Experiência comprovada em vendas consultivas B2B, preferencialmente com SaaS (ciclo de venda, negociação e fechamento).
  • Perfil hands-on, alta autonomia e responsabilidade por metas.
  • Capacidade de conduzir diagnósticos, lidar com objeções e negociar contratos de média complexidade.
  • Organização e disciplina na gestão de pipeline, forecast e cadência comercial.
  • Experiência prática com CRM (ex.: Pipedrive, Salesforce, RD Station CRM, Dynamics, Zoho ou similares).
  • Adaptabilidade para atuar em ambiente dinâmico e em evolução de processos.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência em reestruturação/otimização de processos comerciais e construção de playbooks.
  • Vivência com SaaS, inteligência de mídia, comunicação, reputação, dados, marketing ou martech.
  • Escrita persuasiva e abordagem consultiva orientada a dados.
  • Conhecimento de SCRUM/Agile (ex.: rotina com squads, cerimônias, priorização e entregas iterativas).
  • Formação em Publicidade, Marketing, Comunicação, Administração, Gestão Comercial, Vendas ou áreas correlatas.
  • Diferencial: experiência com sistemas (SaaS/ERP/PDV/CRM/automação) e/ou vendas para empresas de food service (bares, restaurantes, redes, dark kitchens, franquias, distribuidoras e operações multiunidade), entendendo rotinas operacionais, dores de atendimento, controle, compliance e indicadores do setor.

title: Senior Splunk Engineer
description:
Overview

We are seeking an experienced Senior Splunk Engineer to take over and operate the on-premise Splunk SIEM platform. As part of the transition from Infosys, you will be responsible for stabilizing and continuously improving an existing enterprise-scale SIEM environment.


You will own all Splunk operations across Plan & Build, 24/7 Operations, Release & Patch Management, CIM-based Log Onboarding, Parser development, Hardening, Configuration Management, and Incident/Problem/Change processes.


Responsibilities

1. Plan & Build

  • Perform CIM-compliant log onboarding, parser creation, documentation.
  • Conduct onboarding due diligence and demand analysis.
  • Create Firewall/VPN/Routing change requests and validate changes.
  • Manage ingestion pipelines via Cribl, Syslog-ng (TLS), Splunk UF/HF, SCP.
  • Deploy and scale Splunk components using Terraform and Ansible.
  • Build trend and capacity analyses.


2. Operations (24/7 enterprise-grade operations)

  • Ensure full Splunk platform operation, monitoring, performance, EPS/log flow.
  • Handle Incidents, Service Requests, Changes, and Problems under MBG ITSM.
  • Lead Major Incident Management (P1/P2) with 24/7 on-call rotation.
  • Build and operate Health Check dashboards and QA reports.


3. Configuration & Release Management

  • Implement approved changes across Splunk components.
  • Perform daily configuration backups (KV stores, Apps, Configs).
  • Maintain automation libraries (Terraform, Ansible, scripts).
  • Manage Splunk patching and releases (maintain N-1 level).
  • Support up to 12 minor + 1 major release per year.


4. Security, Hardening & Compliance

  • System hardening and vulnerability remediation.
  • Operate via secure access methods (Jump hosts, SuSSHi, 2FA).

title: Desenvolvedor(a) SAP Full Stack - PL/SR
description:
We Transform. SAP® Solutions into Value


A transformação digital ajuda as empresas a atingirem seu potencial máximo - se as tecnologias funcionarem para as pessoas que as utilizam! A NTT DATA Business Solutions está há 30 anos no mercado mundial. Somos uma empresa apaixonada por transformação. E queremos transformar o mundo e as pessoas através das soluções que criamos juntos com nossos parceiros. Aqui projetamos, implementamos, gerenciamos e potencializamos continuamente as soluções SAP para fazê-las funcionar para as empresas – e para as pessoas.


Fazemos parte do grupo NTT DATA – um dos 10 maiores provedores de tecnologia do mundo – segundo o Gartner, e juntos somos mais de 130.000 colaboradores espalhados em 53 países. Nossa meta é impactar positivamente o mundo ajudando a criar uma sociedade mais conectada, diversa e criativa.


Buscamos um(a) profissional SAP FullStack (Pleno ou Sênior) para atuar em ambientes SAP S/4HANA, com foco em desenvolvimento moderno utilizando o modelo RAP e aplicações Fiori. A posição envolve atuação ponta a ponta, desde a camada de dados e serviços até a interface, colaborando com arquitetos e consultores funcionais em times ágeis ou híbridos.


Principais Responsabilidades


  • Desenvolver soluções SAP FullStack no ambiente S/4HANA.
  • Implementar serviços utilizando o modelo RAP (RESTful ABAP Programming Model).
  • Criar e manter CDS Views (projection, exposure e behavior) e Behavior Definitions.
  • Desenvolver Service Definitions e Service Bindings com exposição via OData V4.
  • Construir aplicações com Fiori Elements.
  • Atuar com ABAP OO seguindo boas práticas de Clean Code e qualidade de código.
  • Realizar revisões de código e aplicar padrões de qualidade e sustentabilidade técnica.
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com arquitetos, consultores funcionais e times ágeis.


Requisitos:


  • Experiência prática com SAP S/4HANA.
  • Domínio do modelo RAP.
  • Conhecimento sólido em ABAP Orientado a Objetos.
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de atuação em times ágeis ou híbridos.
  • Mentalidade orientada a Clean Code, qualidade e manutenção evolutiva.


Diferenciais (Desejável):


  • Participação em pelo menos uma implementação greenfield de SAP S/4HANA.
  • Experiência com ATC, SCI ou outras ferramentas de qualidade de código.
  • Certificações SAP.
  • Inglês intermediário/ avançado.


Regime de contratação: CLT

100% Remoto no Brasil

Viagens pontoais (2-3 vezes ao ano)


Liberte todo o seu potencial e engenhosidade – molde o seu próprio futuro. Somos mais do que apenas um local de trabalho; somos uma incubadora de talentos. Com diversos caminhos e oportunidades de aprendizado e carreira de longo prazo, oferecemos inúmeras maneiras de realizar seus sonhos.


*Todas as vagas da NTT DATA são destinadas também para pessoas com deficiência.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
About the Product

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Job Purpose

A Designer on the Content & Engagement team is a skilled strategic thinker who is responsible for crafting highly branded and conversion-optimized creative across the divisions of Carnegie.


Duties and Responsibilities

  • Team Leadership
  • Work with team leaders and colleagues across Carnegie to optimize the team’s efficiency and effectiveness by identifying possible improvements to workflow, and scheduling
  • Champion project collaboration, working to motivate team members and ensure smooth and proactive interactions and processes
  • Design Development
  • Formulate clear and thoughtful content strategies to meet organizational objectives
  • Move design strategies to action, creating high-quality, highly branded, cohesive design constructs across communication channels (print, web, social, video, etc.) that tell a compelling story
  • Foster a collaborative, solutions-oriented culture that champions client success
  • Cross-Divisional Strategy
  • Facilitate knowledge sharing as necessary to ensure that campaign strategy is understood.
  • Be well-versed in translating performance metrics into actionable takeaways
  • Represent content decisions on client discovery and presentation calls with clarity, confidence, and professionalism
  • Optimization & Innovation
  • Analyze conversion metrics to understand what resonates with audiences and drive content iteration
  • Contribute to innovations and improvements in client-facing products and services as well as internal processes
  • Foster a culture of innovation and creative problem-solving by staying up-to-date on industry trends, emerging technologies, and marketing best practices


Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Excellent organizational and highly developed collaboration, problem-solving, and project management skills to thrive in a fast-paced work environment with a large client portfolio
  • Ability to think outside the box to develop bold and innovative storytelling strategies while developing differentiated, compelling, and original creative work
  • Public speaking skills for high levels of client interaction and ability to listen carefully and navigate organizational politics
  • Consistent ability to critically evaluate the quality of creative work and guide revisions while coaching the best creative work from colleagues and direct reports
  • Thorough knowledge of creative tools, including Adobe, Microsoft Office Suite, and Google Office
  • Competency in prompt engineering and utilizing Artificial Intelligence tools, such as ChatGPT and Generative AI, throughout the creative process
  • Effective communication and time management skills for a remote work environment as well as the ability to use/learn multiple technology platforms and switch between them on a regular basis
  • Must be able to work at a computer for prolonged periods
  • Thorough knowledge of print and digital communication development to effectively work across media
  • Due to the remote environment, effective communication and time management skills are required, as well as the ability to use/learn multiple technology platforms and switch between them on a regular basis
  • Physical requirement: Must be able to work at a computer for prolonged periods


Credentials and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Graphic Design, Fine Arts, or related field
  • 3 or more years of professional graphic design experience
  • Robust portfolio of design samples and case studies that demonstrate measurable success


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.
